# AI answer

> A page that answers one question like an article: reasoning, source cards, a streamed answer with headings, lists, a table, code and numbered citations that light the sentence they support, then actions, related questions and a follow-up box.

- Package: `TKCode.Arc.Blocks`, `dotnet add package TKCode.Arc.Blocks --version 0.3.2-preview.1`
- XAML namespace: `xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"`
- Live page: https://docs.tkcode.si/blocks/ai-answer

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiAnswerPreviewDemo">
    <!-- A finished answer, with a responder behind it: point at a citation or a source card, rate it, answer again or ask a follow-up. -->
    <Border Height="720" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiAnswer x:Name="Answer" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiAnswerPreviewDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiAnswerPreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Answer.Providers.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Models().Select(m => new AiModelProvider { Id = m.Id, Name = m.Name }));
        Answer.Models.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Models());
        Answer.Model = Answer.Models[0];

        // A finished answer shows whole, with no word-by-word reveal. The responder answers the next question or the next version.
        Answer.Question = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstQuestion;
        Answer.Answer = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstAnswer;
        Answer.Reasoning = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstReasoning;
        Answer.Sources.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Sources());
        Answer.FollowUps.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Questions.Skip(1));
        Answer.Usage = new AiAnswerUsage(812, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(18.6));
        Answer.Responder = new AiAnswerDemoData.ScriptedResponder();

        // Without a provider the share buttons stay hidden: the block never copies a made-up link.
        Answer.ShareLinkProvider = (info, _) => ValueTask.FromResult("https://example.com/answers/ci-migration" + (info.VersionIndex is { } v ? $"?v={v + 1}" : string.Empty));
    }
}
```

## When to use

The AI answer is for a question that deserves a page, not a chat bubble. It shows how the answer was reached (the reasoning and the sources), writes the answer in full
typography, and lets people check each claim: pointing at a citation shows where the sentence came from.

- **A search or research assistant**: one question in, one cited answer out, with the sources as cards above the text.
- **A help center answer**: the page keeps the question as its title, so it can be shared or copied as a link.
- **An answer that must be verified**: citations, source cards and the sentences they support light each other up, in both directions.
- **An answer that can be improved in place**: try again, shorter, longer or with another model, and page between the versions.

## When not to use

- **A back-and-forth conversation**: use `AiChat`. Asking again here replaces the answer in place.
- **Only a prompt box**: use `AiComposer`.
- **Plain text with no citations**: render it with `Markdown`.
- **Running the model**: the block does not call anything by itself. It asks your `IAiAnswerResponder`, or shows an answer you give it.

## Usage

`AiAnswer` derives from Avalonia's `TemplatedControl` and fills its container, so give it a height. Set a `Responder` and a `Model`, or give it a finished `Answer`.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc">
    <arc:AiAnswer Height="720" Question="Which checks should block a merge during the move?">
        <arc:AiAnswer.Models>
            <arc:AiModel Id="lumen-pro" Name="Lumen Pro 4" />
            <arc:AiModel Id="lumen" Name="Lumen 4" />
        </arc:AiAnswer.Models>
    </arc:AiAnswer>
</UserControl>
```

### Answering with a responder

An `IAiAnswerResponder` receives the question, how it is asked for and the model, and returns the answer as a stream of events.

```csharp
public sealed class MyResponder : IAiAnswerResponder
{
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<AiAnswerEvent> RespondAsync(AiAnswerRequest request, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        yield return new AiAnswerSourcesEvent(sources);            // early, so the sources row fills while the model thinks
        yield return new AiAnswerReasoningEvent("The risk is not the new pipeline...");
        yield return new AiAnswerThoughtEvent();                   // the label turns to "Thought for 8s"
        await foreach (var chunk in StreamAnswerAsync(request, cancellationToken))
        {
            yield return new AiAnswerTextEvent(chunk);              // Markdown, of any size
        }
        yield return new AiAnswerDoneEvent(Tokens: 812, Duration: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(18.6), FollowUps: followUps);
    }
}
```

`request.Mode` is `Answer`, `Retry`, `Concise`, `Detailed` or `SwitchModel`, and `PreviousAnswerMarkdown` is the answer being replaced. The token is cancelled when the person stops the
answer, asks something else or leaves. Throwing an exception fails the answer and shows a note with a Try again button.

### A finished answer

Without a responder, set `Question`, `Answer` (Markdown with `[1]` citations), `Sources`, `Reasoning`, `Usage` and `FollowUps`, and the block shows them whole: no reveal, no follow-up box.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiAnswerStaticDemo">
    <!-- No responder: only the finished answer is shown, with its sources, reasoning and cost. No box to ask another question. -->
    <Border Height="640" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiAnswer x:Name="Answer" Question="Which checks should block a merge during the move?" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiAnswerStaticDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiAnswerStaticDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Answer.Answer = "Block merges on the checks that catch real regressions: the build, the unit tests and the linter. [5]\n\n"
            + "### Keep the list short\n\n"
            + "- Build and unit tests: they fail for real reasons.\n- Lint: cheap and fast.\n- Leave slow device tests as advisory until they are stable. [6]\n\n"
            + "Check the names once after the move, because a renamed job silently stops blocking. [5]";
        Answer.Reasoning = "Required checks are matched by name, so the first thing to protect is the list itself.";
        Answer.Sources.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Sources().Where(s => s.Index is 5 or 6));
        Answer.Sources[0].Index = 5;
        Answer.Sources[1].Index = 6;
        Answer.Model = AiAnswerDemoData.Models()[1];
        Answer.Usage = new AiAnswerUsage(430, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10.2));
    }
}
```

### Reasoning and sources

While the model thinks, the reasoning row shimmers "Thinking"; when the text starts it reads "Thought for 8s" and opens to the reasoning, which can be opened while it is still being written.
The sources row shows up to four overlapping site marks and "N sources"; opened, the sources are cards in two columns, or one row you scroll sideways when the block is narrow (576 and below).
Each card is a link: it raises `SourceInvoked`, and unless you handle the event its `Url` opens. `IsReasoningExpanded` and `IsSourcesExpanded` are two-way.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiAnswerNarrowDemo">
    <!-- At 576 and below the source cards become one row you scroll sideways; the lit card scrolls into view. -->
    <Border Width="390" Height="640" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiAnswer x:Name="Answer" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiAnswerNarrowDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiAnswerNarrowDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Answer.Models.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Models());
        Answer.Question = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstQuestion;
        Answer.Answer = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstAnswer;
        Answer.Reasoning = AiAnswerDemoData.FirstReasoning;
        Answer.Sources.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Sources());
        Answer.FollowUps.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Questions.Skip(1));
        Answer.Responder = new AiAnswerDemoData.ScriptedResponder();

```

### Citations light the sentence

Point at or focus a citation in the text and the sentence just before it, its source card and the pill itself light up; a preview card with the site, the title, an excerpt and the domain
opens after a moment. Point at a source card instead and every sentence that cites it lights, with its pills. At narrow widths the lit card scrolls into view.

### Versions

Answer again, with Try again, More concise, More detailed or Switch model (the models in `Models` other than the current one, in a submenu), adds a **version** of the answer. A pager ("2 / 2") appears
in the action bar; each version keeps its own model, text, cost, rating and whether it was stopped. `CurrentVersionIndex` is two-way and `Versions` lists them.

### Feedback

Thumbs up records at once. Thumbs down opens a small list of reasons (`FeedbackReasons`, or the defaults from `Labels`); choosing one records the rating and thanks the person, and the list closes by itself.
Pressing a rating again takes it back; the two are exclusive, and each version has its own. `FeedbackChanged` reports the value, the reason, the question and the version.

### Copying and sharing

Copy answer puts the text and its numbered sources on the clipboard. The link button and "Share thread" copy a link that **your code** provides through `ShareLinkProvider`: without one, both buttons are hidden,
because the block never copies a link it made up. `Copied` reports what was copied.

### Asking

The box under the answer asks a follow-up; related questions (`FollowUps`, or the ones the responder sends with `AiAnswerDoneEvent`) ask in place. Asking replaces the page: the question, the title and the answer change, and the previous
versions are dropped. `QuestionAsked` is raised first with its origin, and setting `Cancel` asks nothing. `Stop()` or Escape stops an answer: what was written stays, with a note that it may be incomplete and a Try again button.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiAnswerEmptyDemo">
    <Border Height="560" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiAnswer x:Name="Answer" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiAnswerEmptyDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiAnswerEmptyDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Answer.Models.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Models());

        // No question yet: the empty page shows the suggestions. Pressing one asks it and the answer streams in.
        Answer.Suggestions.AddRange(AiAnswerDemoData.Questions);
        Answer.Responder = new AiAnswerDemoData.ScriptedResponder();
    }
}
```

### The empty page

With no question and no answer the page shows a heading, a line of explanation and the `Suggestions` as a list; New thread and Share are disabled and the box takes focus.
`NewThread()` and `NewThreadCommand` go back to it.

### Wording

Every word comes from `Labels` (`AiAnswerLabels`): replace the instance to translate or reword; formatted texts are functions. `Title` wins over the question when set.

### Content guidelines

- **Questions**: whole questions, as a person would ask them.
- **Answers**: a lead sentence that answers, then short sections; cite the claim, not the paragraph.
- **Sources**: a title people recognize, the domain, a date and an excerpt of one or two sentences.
- **Reasoning**: a few sentences of what the model is going to do, not a transcript.

### Best practices

- Send the sources early, before the text that cites them, and number them from 1.
- Always pass the cancellation token on, so stopping really stops.
- Provide a real share link or none.
- Keep related questions to three or four that the sources can answer.

### Common questions

**Why is there no conversation?** The block answers one question at a time; use `AiChat` for a dialogue.

**Why does the copy button include sources?** The answer is only worth copying with where it came from.

**Why are the share buttons missing?** `ShareLinkProvider` is not set.

## API reference

### AiAnswer

A page that answers one question, written like an article: the reasoning first, then the sources as small cards, then the answer streamed in with headings, lists, a table, code and numbered citations. Pointing at a citation lights the sentence it supports and its source card; pointing at a card lights every sentence that cites it. Under the answer are actions (copy, answer again, rate, share, versions), the model line and related questions, and a box asks a follow-up. Asking again replaces the answer in place: this is one question at a time, not a conversation.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Question` | `string?` | `null` | The question (two-way). Null or empty with no answer shows the empty page. Setting it asks it when there is a `Responder`. |
| `Title` | `string?` | `null` | The title of the top bar; null shows the question, or "New thread" on the empty page. |
| `Answer` | `string?` | `null` | A finished answer in Markdown (with "[n]" citations) to show without a responder; it is shown whole, without the word-by-word reveal. |
| `Reasoning` | `string?` | `null` | The reasoning summary of `Answer`, in paragraphs separated by blank lines. |
| `Usage` | `AiAnswerUsage?` | `null` | What `Answer` cost. |
| `Model` | `AiModel?` | `null` | The model; null takes the first of `Models`. |
| `Responder` | `IAiAnswerResponder?` | `null` | Answers a question; null shows only `Answer`. |
| `ShareLinkProvider` | `Func<AiAnswerShareInfo, CancellationToken, ValueTask<string>>?` | `null` | Returns the link to copy for "Share thread" (the whole thread) and the link button of the action bar (one answer). Null hides both buttons: the block never copies a made-up link. |
| `ComposerText` | `string?` | `""` | The text of the follow-up box (two-way). |
| `MaxComposerLines` | `int` | `6` | The follow-up box grows to this many lines and then scrolls. |
| `IsReasoningExpanded` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the reasoning is open (two-way). |
| `IsSourcesExpanded` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the sources are open (two-way). |
| `RevealInterval` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:00.0500000` | How often streamed text is released (50 ms); each step shows a few whole words. |
| `WordsPerStep` | `int` | `4` | How many whole words each step shows (4: about 80 words a second). |
| `Status` | `AiAnswerStatus` | – | *Read-only.* Where the answer is in its life (read-only). |
| `IsBusy` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* Whether the model is thinking or writing (read-only). |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | – | *Read-only.* Why the answer failed (read-only). |
| `CurrentVersionIndex` | `int` | `0` | The shown version (two-way); out of range values are clamped. |
| `AskCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when the person asks a question (the box, a related question, a suggestion), with the question as the parameter. |
| `StopCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when the person stops the answer (the stop button, Escape in the box). |
| `RegenerateCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when the person answers again, with the `AiAnswerMode` (or the chosen `AiModel` for "Switch model") as the parameter. |
| `NewThreadCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when the person starts a new thread. |
| `Labels` | `AiAnswerLabels` | – | Every word the block shows or announces. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QuestionAsked` | `AiAnswerQuestionEventArgs` | Raised before a question is answered; set `Cancel` to ask nothing. |
| `FeedbackChanged` | `AiAnswerFeedbackEventArgs` | Raised when the person rates an answer, finishes a down rating with a reason, or takes a rating back. |
| `SourceInvoked` | `AiAnswerSourceEventArgs` | Raised when a source card or a citation is pressed; set `Handled` to open it yourself. |
| `Copied` | `AiAnswerCopiedEventArgs` | Raised after something was copied. |
| `StatusChanged` | `AiAnswerStatusEventArgs` | Raised when the status changes. |

Pseudo-classes: `:empty`, `:busy`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### AiAnswerVersion

One answer to a question: the model, the text, the reasoning, the sources, what it cost, how it ended and the rating. Asking again (try again, more concise, more detailed, another model) adds a version; the person pages between them.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode` | `AiAnswerMode` | `Answer` | How the answer was asked for. |
| `Model` | `AiModel?` | `null` | The model that wrote it. |
| `Markdown` | `string` | `""` | The answer in the Markdown subset: paragraphs, short headings, ordered and bullet lists, a table, code blocks, bold, inline code and "[n]" citations. |
| `Reasoning` | `string` | `""` | The reasoning summary, in paragraphs separated by blank lines. |
| `Usage` | `AiAnswerUsage?` | `null` | What it cost. |
| `Outcome` | `AiAnswerOutcome` | `Complete` | How it ended. |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | `null` | Why it failed. |
| `Feedback` | `AiAnswerFeedbackValue` | `None` | The rating. |
| `FeedbackReason` | `string?` | `null` | Why the person rated it down. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### Events

| Event | Raised when | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `QuestionAsked` | A question is about to be answered; set `Cancel` to ask nothing | `Question`, `Origin` |
| `FeedbackChanged` | An answer is rated, a down rating gets its reason, or a rating is taken back | `Value`, `Reason`, `Question`, `Version`, `VersionIndex` |
| `SourceInvoked` | A source card or a citation is pressed; set `Handled` to open it yourself | `Item`, `FromCitation` |
| `Copied` | Something was copied | `Kind` (`Answer`, `ShareLink`, `ThreadLink`, `Code`), `Text` |
| `StatusChanged` | The status changes | `OldStatus`, `NewStatus` |

### The responder

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `IAiAnswerResponder` | `RespondAsync(request, cancellationToken)` returns the answer as a stream of events |
| `AiAnswerRequest` | The question, the mode, the model and the answer being replaced |
| `AiAnswerReasoningEvent` | More reasoning text |
| `AiAnswerSourcesEvent` | The sources; send them early |
| `AiAnswerThoughtEvent` | The reasoning is over; the text starts |
| `AiAnswerTextEvent` | More of the Markdown answer, of any size |
| `AiAnswerDoneEvent` | The answer is complete, with its cost and follow-up questions |

## Accessibility

- The block is a region named "AI answer"; the question is a heading that takes focus when a related question or a suggestion asks a new one.
- The reasoning and sources rows are buttons that report whether they are expanded; closed content is removed from the tab order. Source cards are links named "Source 1: title, domain".
- Citations are focusable in reading order, open their card on focus and close it with Escape without moving focus; the lit sentence is a visual aid, so the card carries the same information.
- A polite live region announces "Thinking", "Writing the answer", "Answer ready" or "Answer stopped", failures, copies, ratings, rating changes and version changes. Streamed words are not announced one by one,
  and the answer is marked busy while it is written.
- The action buttons are named and have tooltips; the rating buttons report whether they are pressed; the version pager is a group named "Version 2 of 2".
- Focus goes where the person would look next: back to the answer-again button after its menu, back to the thumbs-down button after the reasons, to the new question after a related question.
- Status never relies on color alone: lit sentences have the card and the number too, failures have an icon and a sentence.
- Reduced motion keeps every state and announcement.

### Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | New thread, Share, the reasoning and sources rows, the citations, the action bar, the related questions, the box |
| `Enter` or `Space` | Presses the focused button or card; on a citation, opens its source |
| `Escape` | Closes a citation card, a menu or the reasons without moving focus; in the box, stops the answer |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` in a menu | Moves between entries; letters jump to a matching entry |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Opens and closes the "Switch model" list |
| `Enter` in the box | Asks; `Shift+Enter` adds a line |

## Motion

- Streamed text is released in whole words about every 50 ms (about four words a step) and each step fades in over 160 ms; headings, list items, table rows and code lines appear when their whole line has arrived.
- Reasoning and sources open on a spring with their content fading in; the source marks fan out when pointed at.
- Lighting a sentence fades its background in over 160 ms.
- Switching versions crossfades the answer; the height follows on a spring, and the digits of the pager roll.
- Menus and the reasons list grow from their button.
- Reduced motion keeps the cadence of the words but drops the fade, the springs and the lighting transition; Off applies every change at once.

| Change | Full | Reduced | Off |
|---|---|---|---|
| New words | Whole words every 50 ms, 160 ms fade | Same batches, no fade | Same batches, no fade |
| Reasoning and sources | Height spring, fades | 120 ms fades | Immediate |
| Lit sentence and card | 160 ms | Immediate | Immediate |
| Version switch | Crossfade; the height springs | 120 ms crossfade | Immediate |
| Menus | Grow from the anchor | 120 ms fade | Immediate |

## Related

- `AiChat` for a conversation.
- `AiComposer` for the prompt box.
- `Markdown` for the text of an answer on its own.
- `ModelPicker` for choosing the model elsewhere.

| Component | Choose it when |
|---|---|
| `AiChat` | People go back and forth |
| `AiComposer` | You only need the box |
| `Markdown` | You only render text |
| `ModelPicker` | The model choice lives on a settings page |

# AI chat

> A chat with an assistant that fills its container: a title menu, a model button and a new chat button on top, a thread with streamed Markdown replies, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, numbered citations and message actions, and a message box at the bottom.

- Package: `TKCode.Arc.Blocks`, `dotnet add package TKCode.Arc.Blocks --version 0.3.2-preview.1`
- XAML namespace: `xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"`
- Live page: https://docs.tkcode.si/blocks/ai-chat

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiChatPreviewDemo">
    <!-- The chat fills its container: give it a height. Ask about the build, or about ci-runner-7 for a failing tool. -->
    <Border Height="680" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiChat x:Name="Chat" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiChatPreviewDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiChatPreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Chat.Providers.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Providers());
        Chat.Models.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Models());
        Chat.Suggestions.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Suggestions());

        var current = AiChatDemoData.NightlyBuild(Chat.Models[0].Id);
        Chat.Conversations.Add(current);
        Chat.Conversations.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.History());
        Chat.CurrentConversation = current;

        // The responder writes each reply as events; the chat shows them as they arrive and lets the person stop a reply.
        Chat.Responder = new AiChatDemoData.ScriptedResponder();
    }
}
```

## When to use

The AI chat is the whole conversation surface of an assistant: the list of past chats, the thread, the model choice and the box
where people write. Replies arrive as a stream, show what the model did on the way (reasoning, searches, queries) and cite
their sources.

- **The main assistant of a product**: a page or a drawer where people ask, follow up, retry and rate.
- **A multi-turn helper inside a dashboard card**: it adapts to its own width, down to a phone-sized column.
- **A place where answers must be checked**: citations preview their source on hover, and tool chips open to show the search
  terms or the query that was run.
- **A conversation that is edited**: editing a message or retrying a reply makes a new version of the turn; the person can go
  back to the earlier one.

## When not to use

- **Only a prompt box**: use `AiComposer`.
- **A person-to-person chat** with participants and read receipts: use `ChatThread`.
- **One question and one long answer**: a page of text with `Markdown` is simpler.
- **Choosing a model on a settings page**: use `ModelPicker`.
- **Running the model**: the chat does not call anything by itself. It asks your `IAiChatResponder`, or it waits for your code to fill the reply.

## Usage

`AiChat` derives from Avalonia's `TemplatedControl` and fills its container, so give it a height. Set a `Responder` to answer, give it
`Models` and a conversation, and handle the events you need.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc">
    <arc:AiChat Height="640" ColumnWidth="760" GreetingText="What should we look at today?">
        <arc:AiChat.Models>
            <arc:AiModel Id="orbit-pro" Name="Orbit Pro 3" Note="Northwind Labs" />
            <arc:AiModel Id="quill-2" Name="Quill 2.4" Note="Fernwood AI" />
        </arc:AiChat.Models>
    </arc:AiChat>
</UserControl>
```

### Answering with a responder

An `IAiChatResponder` receives the messages of the shown branch and returns a stream of events. The chat shows each event as it
arrives; you never touch the views.

```csharp
public sealed class MyResponder : IAiChatResponder
{
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<AiChatStreamEvent> RespondAsync(AiChatRequest request, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        yield return new AiChatReasoningDelta("Compare the stage timings before and after the jump.");
        yield return new AiChatReasoningEnd();
        yield return new AiChatToolUpdate("search", AiChatToolKind.Search, AiChatToolStatus.Running, "Searching the docs");
        // ... the same id again with Status Done, a summary, the queries and the sources
        yield return new AiChatSourcesEvent(sources);              // before the text that cites them
        await foreach (var chunk in model.StreamAsync(request, cancellationToken))
        {
            yield return new AiChatTextDelta(chunk);                // any size; the chat shows whole words on a steady clock
        }
    }
}
```

The events are `AiChatReasoningDelta` and `AiChatReasoningEnd` for the reasoning, `AiChatToolUpdate` for a tool call (updates with the same id change the
same tool), `AiChatSourcesEvent` for the sources, `AiChatTextDelta` for the reply and `AiChatErrorEvent` for a failure. Throwing an exception does the
same as the error event. The token is cancelled when the person stops the reply.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiChatEmptyDemo">
    <Border Height="560" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiChat x:Name="Chat" GreetingText="What should we look at today?" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiChatEmptyDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiChatEmptyDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Chat.Providers.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Providers());
        Chat.Models.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Models());

        // With no current conversation the chat is empty; pressing a suggestion sends its prompt and creates one.
        Chat.Suggestions.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Suggestions());
        Chat.Responder = new AiChatDemoData.ScriptedResponder();
        Chat.ConversationCreated += (_, e) => Chat.Conversations.Add(e.Conversation);
    }
}
```

### The thread

A conversation is an `AiChatConversation` with a title and its `Turns`. Each `AiChatTurn` has versions; a version holds the prompt (`AiChatUserMessage`: text and
attachments), the reply (`AiChatReply`) and the turns that followed it. What is shown is the **visible branch**: the selected version of each turn, then into its
continuation. The responder receives only that branch.

A reply carries its status (thinking, streaming, done, stopped or failed), the reasoning, the tool calls (`AiChatTool`), the sources (`AiSource`), the text
and the person's feedback. Text is the Markdown subset: paragraphs, lists, short headings, bold, inline code, code blocks and `[1]` citations numbered from the
sources in the order they arrived.

### Reasoning, tools and citations

While the model thinks, the head of the reply shows a shimmering "Thinking"; when it is done it reads "Thought for 3s" and opens to the reasoning. Each tool call is
a chip: running (a spinner, not yet openable), done (an icon, the marks of the sources and a short summary such as "3 sources") or failed. A search chip opens to its search
terms and numbered sources; a query chip to its statement and result; a custom tool to your own template (`ToolDetailTemplate`).

A `[1]` in the text becomes a small numbered pill. Pointing at it or focusing it shows a card with the site, the title and an excerpt; pressing it raises
`CitationInvoked`, and unless you handle the event the source's `Url` opens.

### Versions

Retry on a finished reply adds a version of the turn; editing a message and sending it adds a version too. A switcher ("2 / 2") appears in the action bar, and the turns after a
version belong to it, so going back to version 1 brings its follow-ups back. Retry on a failed reply runs again in place and adds no version.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiChatVersionsDemo">
    <Border Height="520" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiChat x:Name="Chat" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiChatVersionsDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiChatVersionsDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Chat.Providers.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Providers());
        Chat.Models.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Models());
        var modelId = Chat.Models[0].Id;

        // A turn with two versions: the first answer and a retry. Press the arrows in the action bar to switch; the turns after a
        // version belong to it. Retry or edit a message to add another version.
        var turn = new AiChatTurn(
            new AiChatUserMessage { Text = "Give me one sentence on why builds slow down over time." },
            new AiChatReply { ModelId = modelId, Text = "Caches stop matching, dependencies grow and test suites accumulate." });
        turn.Versions.Add(new AiChatTurnVersion
        {
            Prompt = new AiChatUserMessage { Text = "Give me one sentence on why builds slow down over time." },
            Reply = new AiChatReply { ModelId = modelId, Text = "Because every added dependency and test is paid for on every single run." }
        });
        turn.SelectedVersionIndex = 1;

        var conversation = new AiChatConversation { Id = "versions", Title = "Why builds slow down", ModelId = modelId };
        conversation.Turns.Add(turn);
        Chat.Conversations.Add(conversation);
        Chat.CurrentConversation = conversation;
        Chat.Responder = new AiChatDemoData.ScriptedResponder();
    }
}
```

### Stopping and failing

While a reply is generated the send button is a stop button and Escape in the box stops it. A stopped reply keeps what was shown and says "Stopped" (or "Stopped before
answering"); a failed one shows an error card with a Retry button. Both keep their action bar except a failed reply, which has none.

### Without a responder

With no `Responder`, a sent message only appears in the thread and raises `MessageSent`; your code fills the `AiChatReply` it gets, and the view follows its changes.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiChatHostDrivenDemo">
    <Border Height="480" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiChat x:Name="Chat" GreetingText="Ask anything" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiChatHostDrivenDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiChatHostDrivenDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        // No responder: a sent message only appears in the thread and raises MessageSent. Your code fills the reply it gets.
        Chat.MessageSent += (_, e) =>
        {
            var reply = e.Turn.SelectedVersion!.Reply;
            reply.Status = AiChatReplyStatus.Thinking;
            var timer = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
            timer.Tick += (_, _) =>
            {
                timer.Stop();
                reply.Text = $"You wrote {e.Prompt.Text.Length} characters. This reply was written by the host, not by a responder.";
                reply.Status = AiChatReplyStatus.Done;
            };
            timer.Start();
        };
    }
}
```

### Conversations, models and new chats

The title button opens the list of `Conversations`, grouped by `Group`, with "New chat" first. Opening one raises `ConversationOpened`; each conversation keeps its own scroll
position and finished replies are not played again. The model button opens `Models`; `SelectedModel` is two-way and `ModelChanged` reports the change. New replies use the
selected model; replies that exist keep the mark of the model that wrote them. "New chat" raises `NewChatRequested`; if nothing handles it, the chat clears
`CurrentConversation` and shows the empty chat with its greeting and up to three `Suggestions`. The first message in an empty chat creates a conversation
(`ConversationCreated`) titled from its first six words.

### Width

The chat follows its own width: at 480 and below the bubbles widen and source domains hide, at 360 and below the buttons tighten. `ColumnWidth` (760) sets the width of the column of turns.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.AiChatNarrowDemo">
    <!-- The chat adapts to its own width: bubbles widen to 88% and source domains hide at 480 and below. -->
    <Border Width="390" Height="560" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="16" ClipToBounds="True" BorderBrush="#33808080" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:AiChat x:Name="Chat" />
    </Border>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class AiChatNarrowDemo : UserControl
{
    public AiChatNarrowDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Chat.Providers.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Providers());
        Chat.Models.AddRange(AiChatDemoData.Models());
        var current = AiChatDemoData.NightlyBuild(Chat.Models[0].Id);
        Chat.Conversations.Add(current);
        Chat.CurrentConversation = current;
        Chat.Responder = new AiChatDemoData.ScriptedResponder();
    }
}
```

### Wording

Every word comes from `Labels` (`AiChatLabels`): replace the instance to translate or reword; formatted texts are functions. `GreetingText` and `PlaceholderText` win over the labels when set.

### Content guidelines

- **Greeting**: a question that invites a task ("What should we look at today?").
- **Suggestions**: three at most, each a real task phrased as the person would say it.
- **Tool labels**: a verb in the present while running ("Searching the docs") and in the past when done ("Searched the docs"); summaries are short ("3 sources", "212 rows", "Timed out").
- **Sources**: a title people recognize, the domain, and an excerpt of one or two sentences.

### Best practices

- Send the sources before the text that cites them, and number citations from 1 in that order.
- Keep tool summaries short; put detail in the panel.
- Let the person stop: always pass the cancellation token on.
- Do not hide failures: an error event gives the person a Retry that runs again in place.

### Common questions

**Why is a sent message not answered?** Without a `Responder` the chat waits for your code to fill the reply.

**Does switching conversations stop a reply?** No. A running reply keeps running, and finished replies are shown at once when you come back.

**Can I show my own tool detail?** Yes: a tool of kind `Custom` is drawn with `ToolDetailTemplate`, with the tool as the data context.

## API reference

### AiChat

A chat with an assistant: a title menu, a model button and a new chat button on top, a thread of turns in the middle and a message box at the bottom. Replies stream in as Markdown with collapsible reasoning, tool chips, numbered citations that preview their source, and actions to copy, retry, rate and switch between versions. Editing a message or retrying a reply makes a new version of the turn; the turns after it belong to the version they followed. The chat calls `Responder` to answer, shows what it sends as it arrives and lets the person stop a reply. Without a responder, a sent message only appears in the thread and raises `MessageSent`, and your code fills the `AiChatReply` itself.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CurrentConversation` | `AiChatConversation?` | `null` | The conversation that is shown (two-way). Null shows the empty chat; the first message then creates one. |
| `SelectedModel` | `AiModel?` | `null` | The selected model (two-way); null selects the first model once. |
| `Responder` | `IAiChatResponder?` | `null` | Provides the replies; null leaves answering to your code. |
| `ColumnWidth` | `double` | `760` | The width of the column of turns (760 by default); the thread is this plus 28 on each side. |
| `GreetingText` | `string?` | `null` | The heading of the empty chat; null shows `Greeting`. |
| `PlaceholderText` | `string?` | `null` | The placeholder of the message box; null shows `Placeholder`. |
| `IsAttachmentEnabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the attach button and dropping files are on. |
| `AcceptedFileTypes` | `string?` | `null` | The file types that may be attached, in the syntax of `FileDropzone.Accept`; null accepts any. |
| `RevealInterval` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:00.0340000` | How often streamed text is released (34 ms): each step shows a few whole words. |
| `WordsPerStep` | `int` | `3` | How many whole words each step shows (3). |
| `ToolDetailTemplate` | `IDataTemplate?` | `null` | Shows the detail of a `Custom` tool; the data context is the `AiChatTool`. |
| `IsFollowingLatest` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* Whether the thread follows new content at the bottom (read-only). |
| `IsBusy` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* Whether a reply of the shown conversation is thinking or streaming (read-only). |
| `NewChatCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Run when the person starts a new chat. |
| `Labels` | `AiChatLabels` | – | Every word the block shows or announces. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MessageSent` | `AiChatMessageSentEventArgs` | Raised when the person sends a message, including an edited one, and when a reply is retried (the turn's new or renewed reply is thinking: without a `Responder` your code answers it). |
| `ReplyCompleted` | `AiChatReplyEventArgs` | Raised when a reply ends: done, stopped or failed. |
| `FeedbackChanged` | `AiChatFeedbackEventArgs` | Raised when the person rates a reply or takes the rating back. |
| `ModelChanged` | `ModelPickerModelChangedEventArgs` | Raised when the person picks another model. |
| `NewChatRequested` | `RoutedEventArgs` | Raised when the person asks for a new chat; set `Handled` to do it yourself. |
| `ConversationOpened` | `AiChatConversationEventArgs` | Raised when the person opens a conversation from the menu. |
| `ConversationCreated` | `AiChatConversationEventArgs` | Raised when the first message of an empty chat creates a conversation. |
| `CitationInvoked` | `AiChatSourceEventArgs` | Raised when the person presses a citation or a source row; set `Handled` to open it yourself. |

Pseudo-classes: `:empty`, `:busy`, `:narrow`, `:compact`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### AiChatConversation

A conversation: a title and the turns of its first version of events.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Id` | `string` | `""` | Stable id. |
| `Title` | `string` | `""` | The title in the menu; empty takes the first six words of the first message, then "Untitled chat". |
| `Group` | `string?` | `null` | The heading of the menu group the conversation is listed under, such as "Today". |
| `ModelId` | `string?` | `null` | The id of the model the conversation last used. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatTurn

A question and its answer, with every version of them (edits and retries).

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SelectedVersionIndex` | `int` | `0` | Which version is shown (two-way). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatTurnVersion

One version of a turn: a prompt, its reply and what happened after it. Editing a prompt or retrying a finished reply adds a version; the turns that came after belong to the version they followed.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Prompt` | `AiChatUserMessage` | – | What the person asked in this version. |
| `Reply` | `AiChatReply` | – | The reply to it. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatUserMessage

What the person wrote: the text and the files attached to it.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Text` | `string` | `""` | The text in the Markdown subset; the bubble shows inline code, the editor the source. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatReply

The assistant's answer to a prompt: reasoning, tool calls, sources, the text and how it ended.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ModelId` | `string?` | `null` | The id of the model that wrote it (an `Id`); decides the mark next to the reply. |
| `Status` | `AiChatReplyStatus` | `Done` | Where the reply is in its life. |
| `Reasoning` | `string` | `""` | The reasoning text, shown under "Thought for 3s" when opened. |
| `ThoughtFor` | `TimeSpan?` | `null` | How long the model thought; null uses the measured time, rounded to seconds (at least 1). |
| `Text` | `string` | `""` | The reply text in the Markdown subset: paragraphs, lists, short headings, bold, inline code, code blocks and "[n]" citations. |
| `ErrorMessage` | `string?` | `null` | Why the reply failed. |
| `Feedback` | `AiChatFeedback` | `None` | The person's rating (two-way). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatTool

A tool call of a reply, such as a search or a query, shown as a chip that can open a detail panel.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Id` | `string` | `""` | Stable id; stream updates with the same id change the same tool. |
| `Kind` | `AiChatToolKind` | `Custom` | What the tool does. |
| `Status` | `AiChatToolStatus` | `Running` | Where the tool call is. |
| `RunningLabel` | `string` | `""` | The name while running, such as "Searching the web". |
| `DoneLabel` | `string` | `""` | The name once done, such as "Searched the web". |
| `Summary` | `string?` | `null` | A short result after the name: "4 sources", "212 rows" or the reason it failed. |
| `Icon` | `object?` | `null` | The icon of a finished tool; null picks Search for searches and a database for queries. |
| `Input` | `string?` | `null` | The statement of a query, shown in a monospace block. |
| `Output` | `string?` | `null` | The result of a query. |
| `OutputLabel` | `string?` | `null` | The label before the result; null shows `AiChatLabels.Result`. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiSource

A source an AI reply drew on: a page, a document or a record. Shown as a numbered citation in the text, as a row in a source list and as a preview card. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so that a change reaches what is on screen.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Index` | `int` | `1` | The number the text cites it with ("[1]"), counted from 1 in the order the sources arrived. |
| `Title` | `string` | `""` | The title of the page or document. |
| `Domain` | `string?` | `null` | The site or place it comes from, such as "docs.example.org". |
| `Url` | `Uri?` | `null` | Where the source can be opened; null makes the citation plain. |
| `Snippet` | `string?` | `null` | A short excerpt shown in the preview card. |
| `Date` | `string?` | `null` | When the source was published or edited, as text ("Mar 3"). |
| `Mark` | `object?` | `null` | The site's small mark: a `Geometry` in a 24 × 24 box or an `IImage`. Null shows the first letter of the domain. |
| `MarkBrush` | `IBrush?` | `null` | The fill of a `Geometry` mark; null uses the secondary text color. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### AiChatSuggestion

A prompt shown in the empty chat that sends itself when pressed.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `""` | The text of the button. |
| `Prompt` | `string?` | `null` | What is sent; null sends the label. |
| `Icon` | `Geometry?` | `null` | A 24 × 24 icon geometry. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### Events

| Event | Raised when | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `MessageSent` | The person sends a message, edited ones included | `Conversation`, `Turn`, `Prompt` |
| `ReplyCompleted` | A reply ends: done, stopped or failed | `Reply` |
| `FeedbackChanged` | A reply is rated or the rating is taken back | `Reply`, `Value` |
| `ModelChanged` | The person picks another model | The old and new model |
| `NewChatRequested` | The person asks for a new chat; set `Handled` to do it yourself | |
| `ConversationOpened` | A conversation is opened from the menu | `Conversation` |
| `ConversationCreated` | The first message of an empty chat creates a conversation | `Conversation` |
| `CitationInvoked` | A citation or a source row is pressed; set `Handled` to open it yourself | `Item` |

### The responder

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `IAiChatResponder` | `RespondAsync(request, cancellationToken)` returns the reply as a stream of events |
| `AiChatRequest` | The conversation, the selected model and the messages of the shown branch, ending with the prompt to answer |
| `AiChatReasoningDelta` / `AiChatReasoningEnd` | More reasoning text; the end of the reasoning with an optional duration |
| `AiChatToolUpdate` | A tool call started or changed (same `Id` updates the same tool) |
| `AiChatSourcesEvent` | The sources the text will cite |
| `AiChatTextDelta` | More of the reply text, of any size |
| `AiChatErrorEvent` | The reply failed, with the message to show |

## Accessibility

- The chat is a region named "AI chat"; the thread is a list of turns, and each message and reply is named by its author.
- The title button is named "Chats, current: …" and the model button "Model: …"; both report that they open a menu, which is a menu with a checked item.
- A polite live region announces that a reply started ("Orbit Pro 3 is replying"), that it finished, was stopped or failed, copies, ratings, version changes, a new
  model and the conversation opened. Streamed words are not announced one by one.
- The reasoning button reports whether it is expanded; tool chips report their state and cannot be opened while running; the version switcher is a group named "Version 2 of 2".
- Citations take focus in reading order, open their card on focus and close it with Escape without moving focus.
- Action buttons are named and have tooltips; they appear on hover and keyboard focus and take no extra space.
- Focus returns where the person was: to the title button after choosing a conversation, to Edit after sending or cancelling an edit, into the box after "New chat".
- Reduced motion keeps every state and announcement.

### Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Title button, model button, new chat, the controls of the thread in reading order, the message box |
| `Enter` or `Space` on a button | Presses it; on the title or model button, opens the menu |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` in a menu | Moves between rows; letters jump to a matching row |
| `Enter` in the message box | Sends (not while a reply is generated or an input method is composing) |
| `Shift+Enter` | Adds a line |
| `Escape` in the message box | Stops the reply being generated |
| `Enter` / `Escape` in the editor of a message | Sends the edit / cancels it |
| `Escape` on a citation | Closes its card without moving focus |

## Motion

- Streamed text is released in whole words on a 34 ms clock (about three words a step), and each step fades in over 150 ms; a finished reply is shown at once.
- Reasoning and tool details open on a spring with their text fading in over 160 ms and out over 100 ms.
- Chips and labels take the width they need on a spring; "Thinking" shimmers until the reasoning ends.
- The thread follows new content at the bottom by closing a fifth of the remaining distance every frame; scrolling up stops it, and a jump button brings it back.
- Switching conversations crossfades the thread; versions fade in at the new height.
- Reduced motion drops springs and movement and keeps the words batched without fading; Off applies every change at once.

| Change | Full | Reduced | Off |
|---|---|---|---|
| New words | Whole words every 34 ms, 150 ms fade | Same batches, no fade | Same batches, no fade |
| Reasoning, tool details | Height spring, fades | 120 ms fades | Immediate |
| Following the bottom | Chases the end | Jumps to the end | Jumps to the end |
| Conversation switch | 100 / 160 ms crossfade | 120 ms crossfade | Immediate |
| Shimmer, spinner | Moving | Still | Still |

## Related

- `AiComposer` for a prompt box without a thread.
- `ModelPicker` for choosing a model on its own.
- `AgentMemory` for what the assistant remembers.
- `Markdown` for the text of a reply on its own.

| Component | Choose it when |
|---|---|
| `AiComposer` | You need the box, not the whole conversation |
| `ChatThread` | The chat is between people |
| `ModelPicker` | The model choice lives on a settings page |
| `Markdown` | You only render text |
