### The page next to the sidebar

By default (`ResizeMode="Overlay"`) the sidebar's layout width changes at once, so the page is laid out one time, and
only the pane springs, drawn above the page. Bind the `RenderTransform` of the page to `PageShift` and the page glides
along with the pane's edge instead of jumping; without the binding the page still lays out correctly and jumps to its
new place. Set `ResizeMode="Push"` and the layout width springs instead, so the page beside it is laid out again on every
frame. That works in any host without a binding and is fine for light pages.

```xml
<DockPanel xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
           xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
           xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
           ClipToBounds="True">
    <arc:Sidebar x:Name="Nav" DockPanel.Dock="Left" ResizeMode="Overlay" />
    <Grid RenderTransform="{Binding #Nav.PageShift}">
        <TextBlock Text="Page content" />
    </Grid>
</DockPanel>
```

`PageShift` is a read-only transform that stays at zero in `Push` mode. The page slides by up to the difference between
the open and the rail width, so give the frame around it a clip (`ClipToBounds="True"`), as the layouts above do. If
you leave the transform out, the page still lays out correctly; it jumps to its new position instead of gliding.

### Filter

`IsFilterVisible` shows a filter box under the header. The filter matches each page's `Label` as a case-insensitive
substring, ignoring leading and trailing spaces; action rows are matched too. A page that matches stays; a parent with
a matching child opens; a section without a matching page hides. When nothing matches, the sidebar shows `NoMatchesText`
in place of the rows. `FilterText` is two-way, and `FilterPlaceholder` names the box.

The filter is a search field: Escape clears it, Down moves focus to the first page left, and Enter chooses the first
page left. The filter only decides which rows are shown, so the selected page stays selected while it is filtered out.
The filter is not applied on the rail.

### Data shape and performance

Keep the model to what navigation needs: a `Key` that is unique across the sidebar (`SelectedKey` finds the first
matching page, and a parent's key is never matched), a short `Label`, one icon and an optional count. Pages with more
than one level belong in a `TreeView`.

- **Batched and incremental.** Changes to `Sections` and to the item collections are batched: the rows are brought in
  step once, after the current batch, so adding several pages in one pass costs one update. Only what changed is
  touched: new pages get new rows, removed pages lose theirs, and the rows of pages that stay keep their controls, their
  focus and their selection.
- **Cheap property changes.** A change to `Badge`, `IsUnread`, `IsAction`, `Icon` or `TrailingIcon` updates that row
  only; a change to `Label` or `IsEnabled` also refreshes the filter and the disabled pages.
- **Closed parents stay out of layout.** A parent or a collapsible section that has closed and settled leaves layout
  and rendering altogether, so a tree with many closed parents is cheap to lay out and draw.
- **Off screen, nothing is held.** While the sidebar is not on screen it holds no rows and no subscriptions to your items,
  so shared or static items do not keep it alive; the rows are built again when it returns.
- **The width spring.** In `Push` mode every frame of the collapse lays the page out again; in `Overlay` mode the page
  is laid out once and only the pane's arrangement changes (see "The page next to the sidebar").

The rows are real controls, so the sidebar suits a few dozen pages; a larger catalog should be grouped or searched with
`CommandPalette`.

### Live data

The sidebar follows its data: change `Badge`, `IsUnread`, `Label`, `Icon` or `IsEnabled` on an item, or add, move and
remove items and sections, and only the rows concerned change. A new page makes its section grow on the same spring as
opening it.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.SidebarLiveUpdatesDemo">
    <StackPanel Spacing="16" HorizontalAlignment="Center">
        <WrapPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center" ItemSpacing="8" LineSpacing="8">
            <arc:Button Content="New message" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnNewMessage" />
            <arc:Button Content="Mark all read" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnMarkRead" />
            <arc:Button Content="Pin a page" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnPin" />
            <arc:Button Content="Unpin" Variant="Ghost" Size="Small" Click="OnUnpin" />
        </WrapPanel>
        <Border Height="400"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                CornerRadius="20"
                BorderThickness="1"
                ClipToBounds="True"
                BorderBrush="{arc:ArcDesignTokenResource Border}">
            <arc:Sidebar x:Name="Nav"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         IsCollapseButtonVisible="False"
                         IsFilterVisible="True"
                         SelectedKey="home">
                <arc:SidebarSection>
                    <arc:SidebarItem Key="home" Label="Home" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.House}" />
                    <arc:SidebarItem Key="inbox" Label="Inbox" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Inbox}" Badge="2" />
                    <arc:SidebarItem Key="drafts" Label="Drafts" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}" />
                </arc:SidebarSection>
                <arc:SidebarSection Header="Pinned" IsCollapsible="True">
                    <arc:SidebarItem Key="pinned/handbook" Label="Team handbook" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.FileText}" />
                </arc:SidebarSection>
            </arc:Sidebar>
        </Border>
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class SidebarLiveUpdatesDemo : UserControl
{
    private static readonly (string Label, Avalonia.Media.Geometry Icon)[] s_pages =
    [
        ("Release plan", ArcIcons.Flag),
        ("Support queue", ArcIcons.MessageSquare),
        ("Brand assets", ArcIcons.Image),
        ("Hiring board", ArcIcons.Users)
    ];

    private int _next;

    public SidebarLiveUpdatesDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
    }

    private SidebarItem Inbox => Nav.Sections[0].Items[1];

    private SidebarSection Pinned => Nav.Sections[1];

    private void OnNewMessage(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        // The row's count follows the item; on the icon rail it shows as a dot.
        var count = int.TryParse(Inbox.Badge, out var n) ? n : 0;
        Inbox.Badge = (count + 1).ToString();
    }

    private void OnMarkRead(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => Inbox.Badge = null;

    private void OnPin(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var (label, icon) = s_pages[_next % s_pages.Length];
        _next++;
        Pinned.IsExpanded = true;
        Pinned.Items.Add(new SidebarItem { Key = $"pinned/{_next}", Label = label, Icon = icon });
    }

    private void OnUnpin(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (Pinned.Items.Count > 0)
        {
            Pinned.Items.RemoveAt(Pinned.Items.Count - 1);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Each line touches only the rows concerned: the other rows keep their controls, focus and selection.
inbox.Badge = "3";
inbox.IsUnread = true;
pinned.Items.Add(new SidebarItem { Key = "pinned/roadmap", Label = "Roadmap", Icon = ArcIcons.Flag });
pinned.Items.RemoveAt(0);
```

footer the signed-in person, so people always know which account they are in.

Keep the keys stable: a key such as `projects/atlas` is what a bookmark or a deep link stores, so renaming the label
is safe and changing the key is not.

### Content guidelines

- **Label**: a short noun or noun phrase in sentence case, such as "Invoices" or "Team members". Use the words the page
  itself uses in its heading, so the row and the page title agree.
- **Action row**: a verb and its object in sentence case, such as "New project". Everything else in the sidebar is a
  noun, so the verb tells people the row does something instead of opening a page.
- **Section heading**: a group name in sentence case, without a verb. Leave the heading out when the group has one
  obvious purpose, as Home and Inbox do.
- **Count**: digits only, and a count only for things that wait for the person: unread messages, open alerts, pending
  reviews. A count that never changes is a label. When the number does not matter, use the unread dot.

| Instead of | Write |
|---|---|
| Home Page | Home |
| Click here to see your invoices | Invoices |
| Reports (NEW!!) | Reports |
| Team & Permissions Management | Team members |
| Stuff you can change | Settings |
| Add a new project to your workspace | New project |

### Best practices

**Do**

- Put the places people visit most in the first section, where it has no heading; reserve headed sections for groups
  with a clear name. The first section is the first thing the eye reads.
- Bind `SelectedKey` to the route and keep the keys stable, so a deep link, a bookmark and the selected row agree.
- Show a count or an unread dot only for work that waits for the person, and update it in place; a mark that grows
  stale teaches people to ignore it.
- Set `ResizeMode="Overlay"`, bind the page's `RenderTransform` to `PageShift` and clip the frame when the page next to
  the sidebar has a lot of content.
- Fade what you put in the header and footer with the `:collapsed` pseudo-class, and keep a logo or an avatar at the
  leading edge so something recognizable stays on the rail.

**Avoid**

- Making a parent the only way to reach a page. A parent opens and closes but is never selected, so a parent with no
  landing page sends people to a dead end. Add a child for the landing page instead.
- Using action rows for more than a place or two. "New project" and "More" suit the list they end; "Log out" belongs in
  a menu or a button, because a row that changes the page makes people expect a place.
- Nesting more than one level, or building a folder tree in it. Only one level of children is shown, and a deeper tree
  is hard to scan and to navigate with the arrow keys.
- Long labels. The label shares a 216 px row with the icon and the count, the rail tooltip shows the same text, and the
  filter matches it, so a short, distinct label is easier to find in every mode.
- Setting `Width` on the sidebar. The theme sets the open and rail widths, and the collapse springs between them; a
  local width overrides both and stops the collapse from changing the width.
- Sharing one control between rows as an icon. A control can sit in one row only; give each item its own, or use a
  geometry.

### Common questions

**Why does choosing a parent not open a page?** A parent is never selected. Choosing it opens or closes its pages.
Give the parent a child page for its landing view, and bind `SelectedKey` to that child's key.

**How do I hide a page instead of disabling it?** Remove the item from its parent's or section's `Items`. The rows
update in place, and the page reappears when you add it back. `IsEnabled="False"` keeps the page visible, dimmed, and
out of the arrow key order.

**What happens when `SelectedKey` names a page that does not exist?** Nothing is selected, and the key keeps its value.
When a page with that key is added later, the sidebar selects it. This lets a route set at startup work before the
navigation data has loaded.

**Can an action row be selected?** No. An `IsAction` row raises `ItemInvoked` and runs its commands, but `SelectedItem`
and `SelectedKey` stay where they were, so the page the person is on keeps its marker.

**Why does the page next to the sidebar stutter while it collapses?** In `Push` mode the page is laid out
on every frame of the width spring. Use the default `ResizeMode="Overlay"` and bind the page's `RenderTransform` to `PageShift`.

**Why does Cmd+B or Ctrl+B not collapse the sidebar?** The shortcut works only while focus is inside the sidebar, on
one of its rows or in its filter. Click a row first, or bind `IsCollapsed` to a toggle button elsewhere in the window.

## API reference

### Sidebar

The app's main navigation (an original TKCode design): a header for a logo or a workspace switcher, an optional filter box, sections of pages with icons, counts and one level of nested pages, and a footer for the signed-in user. The selected page carries a muted block behind it and an accent-colored icon; the block glides between rows on a snappy spring. Parents open their pages with a height spring and a turning chevron. The sidebar collapses to a 64px icon rail on a width spring: labels and counts fade, counts become dots, every page gets a tooltip on the right and a parent shows its pages in a menu. Keyboard (WAI-ARIA tree model): the list is one tab stop; ↑ / ↓, Home / End move, → opens a parent or enters it, ← closes it or goes back to the parent, Enter / Space choose, typing jumps to a page by its first letters, and Cmd / Ctrl+B collapses or expands the sidebar while focus is inside it.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SelectedItem` | `SidebarItem?` | `null` | The selected page (two-way). A parent cannot be selected: choosing it opens and closes its pages. |
| `SelectedKey` | `string?` | `null` | The `Key` of the selected page (two-way), kept in step with `SelectedItem`; bind it to your route. |
| `IsCollapsed` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the sidebar is the 64px icon rail (two-way). The width springs between the two. |
| `Header` | `object?` | `null` | Content at the top (a logo and title, a workspace switcher), beside the collapse button when that sits in the header row. It is hidden on the rail while the collapse button shows. |
| `Footer` | `object?` | `null` | Content at the bottom (the signed-in user, a storage meter), under a thin separator. It keeps its open-width layout on the rail, clipped to the rail; use the `:collapsed` pseudo-class to adapt it. |
| `IsFilterVisible` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the filter box under the header (it becomes a search button on the rail). |
| `FilterText` | `string` | `""` | The filter text (two-way). Pages whose label contains it stay; a parent with a matching page opens. |
| `FilterPlaceholder` | `string` | `"Filter"` | Placeholder and accessible name of the filter box. |
| `NoMatchesText` | `string` | `"No matches"` | Text shown when the filter matches no page. |
| `IsCollapseButtonVisible` | `bool` | `true` | Shows the collapse / expand button (PanelLeft icon). Its place is `CollapseButtonPlacement`. |
| `CollapseButtonPlacement` | `SidebarCollapseButtonPlacement` | `Header` | Where the collapse button sits while the sidebar is open: in the header row (default) or beside the filter box. On the rail it always sits at the top. |
| `CollapseButtonText` | `string` | `"Collapse sidebar"` | Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is open. |
| `ExpandButtonText` | `string` | `"Expand sidebar"` | Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is the rail. |
| `ResizeMode` | `SidebarResizeMode` | `Overlay` | How the width change between the open sidebar and the rail reaches the page next to it: `Overlay` (default) or `Push`. |
| `UnreadText` | `string` | `"unread"` | Added to the accessible name of a page that has `IsUnread` ("Inbox, unread"). |
| `Label` | `string` | `"Sidebar"` | Name of the navigation landmark. |
| `SelectCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when a page is chosen; the parameter is the `SidebarItem`. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ItemInvoked` | `SidebarItemInvokedEventArgs` | Raised when a page is chosen (click, Enter or Space, or a page in a rail menu), also when it already was the selected page. |

Pseudo-classes: `:collapsed`, `:filtering`, `:filter-toggle`, `:overlay-resize`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### SidebarSection

One group of pages in a `Sidebar`: an optional small heading over its `Items`. A collapsible section folds its pages away under the heading; on the icon rail sections are separated by a thin line instead.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Header` | `string?` | `null` | The small heading over the pages; null shows no heading (for example the first group: Home, Inbox). |
| `IsCollapsible` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the heading is a button that folds the pages away (it shows a small chevron). Needs a `Header`. |
| `IsExpanded` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the pages of a collapsible section are shown (two-way). Ignored when the section is not collapsible. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### SidebarItem

One page of a `Sidebar`: a row with an icon, a label and an optional count. An item with `Items` is a parent: it opens and closes its child pages instead of being selected (one level of nesting).

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Key` | `string?` | `null` | A stable id for the page (a route or view name); `SelectedKey` selects by it. |
| `Label` | `string` | `""` | The row text; also the tooltip on the icon rail and the text that typing and the filter match. |
| `Icon` | `object?` | `null` | The 16px leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (for example an `ArcIcons` glyph) or any control. |
| `TrailingIcon` | `object?` | `null` | An icon after the label, in the label's muted color (for example a chevron on a "More" row): a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` or any control. |
| `Badge` | `string?` | `null` | A short count at the end of the row (for example "12"); on the icon rail it becomes a dot on the icon. Null shows nothing. |
| `IsUnread` | `bool` | `false` | Marks the page as having something new: a small accent dot at the end of the row, a stronger label, and a dot on the icon on the rail. |
| `IsAction` | `bool` | `false` | Makes the row an action instead of a page: muted, never selected. Choosing it raises `ItemInvoked` and runs the commands, but `SelectedItem` stays (for example "New project", "More"). |
| `IsExpanded` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the child pages of a parent are shown (two-way). |
| `IsEnabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the page can be chosen. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys. |
| `Command` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Runs when the page is chosen (with `CommandParameter`). |
| `CommandParameter` | `object?` | `null` | The parameter passed to `Command`. |
| `Tag` | `object?` | `null` | Any value you want back when the page is chosen. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

## Accessibility

- The sidebar is a navigation landmark named by `Label` ("Sidebar" by default). Use a specific name such as "Main
  navigation" when a page has more than one navigation region.
- The pages form a tree. Each row is named by its label, its count and "unread" when it has `IsUnread` ("Inbox, 12"),
  reports whether it is selected, and a parent reports whether it is expanded. `UnreadText` localizes the word.
- A collapsible section heading is a disclosure button; other headings are text and are not in the tab order.
- The collapse buttons and the rail's search button are named by `CollapseButtonText`, `ExpandButtonText` and
  `FilterPlaceholder`. Override them to localize. A button that is hidden (the one in the header while the other sits
  beside the filter) takes no focus.
- On the rail each page keeps its label as a tooltip, so people who use a pointer can still read the names of the
  icons. A parent's menu opens from the keyboard with Right or Enter and lists its pages as radio items.
- Keyboard focus shows a 2 px focus ring around the row. Disabled pages are dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.
- Do not rely on color alone: the unread dot is paired with a stronger label and the word "unread" in the accessible
  name, and a count is part of the name.

### Keyboard

The sidebar follows the WAI-ARIA tree model for navigation. The list is one tab stop, and it starts on the selected
page, or on the first page when none is selected.

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Enter the list on the focused or selected row, or leave it |
| `Up` / `Down` | Move to the previous or next visible row; disabled pages are skipped |
| `Home` / `End` | Move to the first or last visible row |
| `Page Up` / `Page Down` | Move by about one visible page of rows |
| `Right` | Open a parent, or move into its first page when it is open; on the rail, open its menu |
| `Left` | Close an open parent, or move from a child to its parent; from a page of a collapsible section, go up to its heading |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Choose a page or an action; open or close a parent, or fold a collapsible section heading |
| Letters | Jump to the next visible page whose label starts with the typed text |
| `Cmd+B` (`Ctrl+B` on Windows and Linux) | Collapse or expand the sidebar while focus is inside it |
| `Down`, `Enter`, `Escape` in the filter | Move to the first page; choose the first page left; clear the filter |

## Motion

- The selection block, a muted wash with no bar, glides between rows on a snappy spring; the icon of the selected page
  changes to the accent color. When the selected page folds away inside its parent, the block rests on the parent.
- Parents and collapsible sections open and close on a smooth height spring while the chevron turns on a snappy one. A
  closed one leaves layout and rendering altogether once it has settled. A new page makes its section grow on the same
  spring.
- Collapsing to the rail springs the width (smooth). The text of every row (label, trailing icon, count, unread dot and
  chevron) fades out together while icons stay in place, and counts and unread marks turn into dots on the icons. In
  `Overlay` mode the spring runs on the pane alone and keeps its speed when you toggle again in the middle of it; in
  `Push` mode it restarts from the current width.
- Reduced motion changes the width and the heights at once, turns the chevrons at once and moves the selection block
  at once. The text of the rows, the header, the filter box and the search button still fade quickly.
- Off applies every change at once.

| Change | Full | Reduced | Off |
|---|---|---|---|
| The selection block moves | Glides between rows on a snappy spring | Jumps to the row | Jumps to the row |
| A parent or collapsible section opens or closes | Height springs (smooth) and the chevron turns (snappy) | Height and chevron change at once | Immediate |
| A page is added to a section | The section grows on the height spring (smooth) | Grows at once | Immediate |
| The sidebar collapses or expands | Width springs (smooth); in `Overlay` mode only the pane springs | Width changes at once | Immediate |
| The text of a row and the section headings on the rail | Fade quickly (fast) | Fade quickly (fast) | Immediate |
| The header, the filter box and the search button on the rail | Fade quickly (fast) | Fade quickly (fast) | Immediate |
| Row hover and press | Background and text color crossfade (fast) | Change at once | Immediate |

## Related

- `Drawer` hosts the sidebar on narrow windows, where a fixed sidebar would take too much room.
- `Tabs` to switch between views of one page.
- `TreeView` for deep folder trees.
- `CommandPalette` for keyboard search across pages and actions.
- `UserMenu` or `DropdownMenu` in the header and footer, for a workspace switcher or an account menu.

| Component | Choose it when |
|---|---|
| `Tabs` | Two to five views share one object and its header stays in view |
| `Breadcrumb` / `Stepper` | The place in a hierarchy or the position in a sequence is the point |
| `TreeView` | The pages or files nest more than one level deep |
| `CommandPalette` | People search for a page or an action by name rather than browse |
| `Drawer` | The window is too narrow for a fixed sidebar and the navigation should slide in |
| `UserMenu` | The signed-in person needs a menu of account actions in the header or footer |

```cs
    private static readonly (string Name, string Note, string State)[] Milestones =

        ("Saved payment methods", "Shipped Sep 18", "done"),

        ("Staged rollout", "Planned for Oct 14", "planned")
    ];

    private static readonly (string Who, string Text, string Time)[] Activity =
    [
        ("Ava Mitchell", "moved CHK-131 to review", "1h ago"),
        ("Marcus Johnson", "merged the saved cards endpoint", "3h ago"),
        ("Emma Collins", "shared Checkout flows v3", "Yesterday"),
        ("Sofia Ramirez", "closed CHK-119, a double charge on retry", "Yesterday"),
        ("Jasmine Brooks", "set the rollout date to October 14", "Sep 17")
    ];

    private readonly PageHeaderAction _follow = new() { Label = "Follow", Icon = ArcIcons.Bell, MenuIcon = ArcIcons.Bell };
    private readonly PageHeaderAction _share = new() { Label = "Share update", Icon = Megaphone };
    private readonly PageHeaderAction _copyLink = new() { Label = "Copy link", Icon = ArcIcons.Link2 };
    private readonly PageHeaderAction _archive = new() { Label = "Archive project", Icon = ArcIcons.Archive };
    private readonly PageHeaderAction _newIssue = new() { Label = "New issue", Icon = ArcIcons.Plus };

    private readonly List<(Issue Issue, PresenceHost Row, Button Check)> _issues = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> _closing = new();
    private readonly List<IDisposable> _timers = new();
    private int _done = DoneAtStart;

    private int _issueCounter;
    private int _updateCounter;
    private bool _following;
    private bool _archived;
    private bool _sharing;

    public PageHeaderPreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Header.Breadcrumbs = new AvaloniaList<string> { "Northline", "Projects", "Checkout redesign" };
        Header.Actions.Add(_follow);
        Header.Actions.Add(_share);
        Header.MoreActions.Add(_copyLink);
        Header.MoreActions.Add(_archive);
        Header.PrimaryAction = _newIssue;
        Header.BreadcrumbClick += OnBreadcrumbClick;
        _follow.Click += (_, _) => ToggleFollow();
        _share.Click += (_, _) => ShareUpdate();
        _copyLink.Click += (_, _) => CopyLink();
        _archive.Click += (_, _) => ToggleArchive();
        _newIssue.Click += (_, _) => CreateIssue();

        Members.ItemsSource = new[] { "Emma Collins", "Marcus Johnson", "Ava Mitchell", "Sofia Ramirez", "Jasmine Brooks" }
            .Select(name => new AvatarGroupMember(name)).ToList();
        for (var i = 0; i < Milestones.Length; i++)
        {
            MilestoneList.Children.Add(MilestoneRow(Milestones[i].Name, Milestones[i].Note, Milestones[i].State, i == Milestones.Length - 1));
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < Activity.Length; i++)
        {
            ActivityList.Children.Add(ActivityRow(Activity[i].Who, Activity[i].Text, Activity[i].Time, i == Activity.Length - 1));
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < Files.Length; i++)
        {
            FileList.Children.Add(FileRow(Files[i], i == Files.Length - 1));
        }
        FilesTab.Count = Files.Length;
        foreach (var update in StartingUpdates)
        {
            UpdateList.Children.Add(UpdateRow(update, fresh: false));
        }
        _updates = StartingUpdates.Length;
        MarkLast(UpdateList.Children.ToList());
        UpdatesTab.Count = _updates;
        foreach (var issue in StartingIssues)
        {
            AddIssue(issue, atTop: false, fresh: false);
        }
        RefreshIssueState();
        DetachedFromVisualTree += (_, _) => StopTimers();
    }

    #region Actions (simulated)

    private void ToggleFollow()
    {
        _following = !_following;
        _follow.Label = _following ? "Following" : "Follow";
        _follow.Icon = _following ? BellRing : ArcIcons.Bell;
        _follow.MenuLabel = _following ? "Unfollow" : "Follow";
        _follow.MenuIcon = _following ? ArcIcons.BellOff : ArcIcons.Bell;
        Notify(_following ? "Following Checkout redesign" : "Stopped following Checkout redesign",
            _following ? ToastKind.Success : ToastKind.Info);
    }

    private void ShareUpdate()
    {
        if (_archived || _sharing)
        {
            return;
        }
        _sharing = true;
        _share.IsLoading = true;
        Later(700, () =>
        {
            var body = DraftUpdates[_updateCounter++ % DraftUpdates.Length];
            UpdateList.Children.Insert(0, UpdateRow(new Update("Jasmine Brooks", "Just now", true, body), fresh: true));
            UpdatesTab.Count = ++_updates;
            MarkLast(UpdateList.Children.ToList());
            _share.IsLoading = false;
            _share.Label = "Shared";
            _share.Icon = ArcIcons.Check;
            Header.RevealTab(2);
            Notify("Update shared with the project team", ToastKind.Success);
            Later(1800, () =>
            {
                _sharing = false;
                _share.Label = "Share update";
                _share.Icon = Megaphone;
            });
        });
    }

    private void CreateIssue()
    {
        if (_archived)
        {
            return;
        }
        var index = _issueCounter++;
        var issue = new Issue($"CHK-{139 + index}", DraftIssues[index % DraftIssues.Length], "Jasmine Brooks", "Triage");
        AddIssue(issue, atTop: true, fresh: true);
        RefreshIssueState();
        Header.RevealTab(1);
        Notify($"{issue.Id} created and assigned to you", ToastKind.Success);
    }

    private void ToggleArchive()
    {
        _archived = !_archived;
        Header.Status = _archived ? "Archived" : "On track";
        Header.StatusTone = _archived ? BadgeTone.Neutral : BadgeTone.Success;
        _archive.Label = _archived ? "Restore project" : "Archive project";
        _archive.Icon = _archived ? ArchiveRestore : ArcIcons.Archive;
        _share.IsEnabled = !_archived && !_sharing;
        _newIssue.IsEnabled = !_archived;
        Notify(_archived ? "Project archived. New issues and updates are paused." : "Project restored", ToastKind.Info);
    }

    private async void CopyLink()
    {
        var copied = await ArcClipboard.CopyTextAsync(this, ProjectUrl);
        Notify(copied ? "Link copied" : "Couldn't copy the link. Try again from the address bar.",
            copied ? ToastKind.Success : ToastKind.Error);
    }

    private void OnBreadcrumbClick(object? sender, PageHeaderBreadcrumbClickEventArgs e)
        => Notify($"{e.Item} would open here.", ToastKind.Info);

    private void OnRestoreIssuesClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        foreach (var (_, row, _) in _issues)
        {
            IssueList.Children.Remove(row);
        }
        _issues.Clear();
        _closing.Clear();
        foreach (var issue in StartingIssues)
        {
            AddIssue(issue, atTop: false, fresh: false);
        }
        _done = DoneAtStart;
        RefreshIssueState();
        Notify("Sample issues restored", ToastKind.Info);
    }

    private void CompleteIssue(Issue issue, Button check)
    {
        if (!_closing.Add(issue.Id))
        {
            return;
        }
        // The check fills and the title strikes through, then the row closes its own height.
        check.Classes.Add("closing");
        check.Content = Glyph(ArcIcons.CircleCheck, 18);
        if (check.Tag is TextBlock title)
        {
            title.Classes.Add("closing");
        }
        Later(380, () =>
        {
            var index = _issues.FindIndex(entry => entry.Issue.Id == issue.Id);
            if (index < 0)
            {
                return;
            }
            var hadFocus = check.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
            var row = _issues[index].Row;
            _issues.RemoveAt(index);
            _closing.Remove(issue.Id);
            row.Exited += (_, _) => IssueList.Children.Remove(row);
            row.IsPresent = false;
            _done++;
            RefreshIssueState();
            Notify($"{issue.Id} marked done", ToastKind.Success);
            if (hadFocus && _issues.Count > 0)
            {
                _issues[Math.Min(index, _issues.Count - 1)].Check.Focus();
            }
        });
    }

    private void RefreshIssueState()
    {
        MarkLast(_issues.Select(entry => entry.Row).ToList());
        IssuesTab.Count = _issues.Count;
        IssuesEmpty.IsPresent = _issues.Count == 0;
        var total = _done + _issues.Count;
        IssueProgress.Maximum = total;
        IssueProgress.Value = _done;
        IssueProgress.Label = $"{_done} of {total} issues done";
    }

    private void Notify(string text, ToastKind kind)
        => Notices.Show(new ToastOptions { Id = "page-header-notice", Kind = kind, Title = text, Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(3200) });

    private void Later(int milliseconds, Action run)
    {
        IDisposable? handle = null;
        handle = DispatcherTimer.RunOnce(() =>
        {
            _timers.Remove(handle!);
            run();
        }, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(milliseconds));
        _timers.Add(handle);
    }

    private void StopTimers()
    {
        foreach (var timer in _timers)
        {
            timer.Dispose();
        }
        _timers.Clear();
    }

    #endregion

    #region Rows

    private void AddIssue(Issue issue, bool atTop, bool fresh)
    {
        var check = new Button { Variant = ButtonVariant.Ghost, Content = Glyph(ArcIcons.Circle, 18) };
        check.Classes.Add("check");
        AutomationProperties.SetName(check, $"Mark {issue.Id} done");
        var title = new TextBlock { Text = issue.Title, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        title.Classes.Add("issue-title");
        check.Tag = title;
        check.Click += (_, _) => CompleteIssue(issue, check);

        var id = Note(issue.Id);
        id.MinWidth = 60;
        var text = new DockPanel { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        DockPanel.SetDock(id, Dock.Left);
        id.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 12, 0);
        text.Children.Add(id);
        text.Children.Add(title);

        var grid = new Grid { ColumnDefinitions = new ColumnDefinitions("32,*,Auto,Auto"), ColumnSpacing = 12, MinHeight = 44 };
        Place(grid, check, 0);
        Place(grid, text, 1);
        var label = Note(issue.Label);
        label.Classes.Add("wide-only");
        Place(grid, label, 2);
        Place(grid, new Avatar { DisplayName = issue.Owner, Size = AvatarSize.Small }, 3);

        var row = Row(Highlighted(Inset(grid, new Thickness(10, 4)), fresh), fresh);
        if (fresh)
        {
            // A new row opens its own height and arrives lit, then settles to the page.
            row.Loaded += (_, _) => row.IsPresent = true;
        }
        if (atTop)
        {
            IssueList.Children.Insert(0, row);
            _issues.Insert(0, (issue, row, check));
        }
        else
        {
            IssueList.Children.Add(row);
            _issues.Add((issue, row, check));
        }
    }

    private Control UpdateRow(Update update, bool fresh)
    {
        var badge = new Badge
        {
            Size = BadgeSize.Small,
            Tone = update.OnTrack ? BadgeTone.Success : BadgeTone.Warning,
            Content = update.OnTrack ? "On track" : "At risk",
            Icon = Dot(update.OnTrack ? "success" : "warning")
        };
        var head = new WrapPanel { ItemSpacing = 10, LineSpacing = 4, MinHeight = 22 };
        head.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = update.Author, FontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
        head.Children.Add(Note(update.Date));
        head.Children.Add(badge);
        var body = new TextBlock { Text = update.Body, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, MaxWidth = 560, Margin = new Thickness(0, 6, 0, 0), HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left };
        Bind(body, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, ArcDesignTokenKind.TextSecondary);
        var text = new StackPanel { Children = { head, body } };

        var grid = new Grid { ColumnDefinitions = new ColumnDefinitions("Auto,*"), ColumnSpacing = 14 };
        var avatar = new Avatar { DisplayName = update.Author, Size = AvatarSize.Medium, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top };
        Place(grid, avatar, 0);
        Place(grid, text, 1);

        var row = Row(Highlighted(Inset(grid, new Thickness(10, 18)), fresh), fresh);
        if (fresh)
        {
            row.Loaded += (_, _) => row.IsPresent = true;
        }
        return row;
    }

    private static Control MilestoneRow(string name, string note, string state, bool last)
    {
        var icon = Glyph(state == "done" ? ArcIcons.CircleCheck : state == "active" ? CircleDashed : ArcIcons.Circle, 16);
        icon.Classes.Add(state);
        var grid = new Grid { ColumnDefinitions = new ColumnDefinitions("16,*,Auto"), ColumnSpacing = 12, MinHeight = 48 };
        Place(grid, icon, 0);
        Place(grid, new TextBlock { Text = name, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis }, 1);
        Place(grid, Note(note), 2);
        return ListRow(grid, last);
    }

    private static Control ActivityRow(string who, string text, string time, bool last)
    {
        var line = new TextBlock { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap };
        Bind(line, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, ArcDesignTokenKind.TextSecondary);
        var name = new Avalonia.Controls.Documents.Run(who) { FontWeight = FontWeight.Medium };
        Bind(name, Avalonia.Controls.Documents.TextElement.ForegroundProperty, ArcDesignTokenKind.Foreground);
        line.Inlines = new Avalonia.Controls.Documents.InlineCollection { name, new Avalonia.Controls.Documents.Run(" " + text) };
        var grid = new Grid { ColumnDefinitions = new ColumnDefinitions("Auto,*,Auto"), ColumnSpacing = 12, MinHeight = 52 };
        Place(grid, new Avatar { DisplayName = who, Size = AvatarSize.Small, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center }, 0);
        Place(grid, line, 1);
        Place(grid, Note(time), 2);
        return ListRow(grid, last);
    }

    private static Control FileRow((string Name, string Kind, string Size, string Owner, string Date, Geometry Icon) file, bool last)
    {
        var icon = Glyph(file.Icon, 16);
        icon.Classes.Add("file");
        var name = new StackPanel { VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        name.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = file.Name, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis });
        name.Children.Add(Note($"{file.Kind}, {file.Size}"));
        var date = Note(file.Date);
        date.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
        date.Classes.Add("wide-only");
        date.MinWidth = 52;
        date.TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Right;
        var grid = new Grid { ColumnDefinitions = new ColumnDefinitions("16,*,Auto,Auto"), ColumnSpacing = 14, MinHeight = 56 };
        Place(grid, icon, 0);
        Place(grid, name, 1);
        Place(grid, new Avatar { DisplayName = file.Owner, Size = AvatarSize.Small, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center }, 2);
        Place(grid, date, 3);
        return ListRow(grid, last);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A row that opens and closes its own height (Arc: overflow-y clip). It reaches 10px past the list on both sides
    /// so the lit row and the check's hover stay whole, while its rule spans only the list.
    /// </summary>
    private static PresenceHost Row(Control content, bool fresh)
    {
        var rule = ListRow(content, last: false);
        rule.Margin = new Thickness(10, 0);
        return new PresenceHost
        {
            Mode = PresenceMode.Fade,
            Collapse = PresenceCollapse.Height,
            Spring = ArcSpring.Smooth,
            IsPresent = !fresh,
            ClipToBounds = true,
            Margin = new Thickness(-10, 0),
            Child = rule
        };
    }

    /// <summary>The last row of a list drops its rule (Arc: :last-child).</summary>
    private static void MarkLast(IReadOnlyList<Control> rows)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
        {
            if (rows[i] is PresenceHost { Child: Border border })
            {
                border.Classes.Set("last", i == rows.Count - 1);
            }
        }
    }

    private static Border ListRow(Control content, bool last)
    {
        var border = new Border { Child = content };
        border.Classes.Add("list-row");
        if (last)
        {
            border.Classes.Add("last");
        }
        return border;
    }

    /// <summary>A fresh row arrives lit (6% of the foreground) and fades to the page over 1.8s.</summary>
    private Control Highlighted(Control content, bool fresh)
    {
        if (!fresh)
        {
            return content;
        }
        var glow = new Border { Opacity = 0.06 };
        glow.Classes.Add("fresh");
        Later(630, () =>
        {
            glow.Transitions = new Avalonia.Animation.Transitions
            {
                new Avalonia.Animation.DoubleTransition { Property = OpacityProperty, Duration = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1170) }
            };
            glow.Opacity = 0;
        });
        return new Panel { Children = { glow, content } };
    }

    /// <summary>Rows bleed 10px past the list on both sides so the fresh highlight has room (Arc: margin-inline -10px).</summary>
    private static Border Inset(Control content, Thickness padding)
        => new() { Margin = new Thickness(-10, 0), Padding = padding, Child = content };

    private static TextBlock Note(string text)
    {
        var note = new TextBlock { Text = text };
        note.Classes.Add("note");
        return note;
    }

    private static ArcGlyph Glyph(Geometry data, double size)
        => new() { Data = data, Size = size, StrokeThickness = 1.75, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };

    private static Ellipse Dot(string tone)
    {
        var dot = new Ellipse { Width = 6, Height = 6 };
        dot.Classes.Add(tone);
        return dot;
    }

    private static void Place(Grid grid, Control child, int column)
    {
        Grid.SetColumn(child, column);
        if (child.VerticalAlignment == VerticalAlignment.Stretch)
        {
            child.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
        }
        grid.Children.Add(child);
    }

    private static void Bind(AvaloniaObject target, AvaloniaProperty property, ArcDesignTokenKind kind)
    {
        if (target is StyledElement element)
        {
            ArcTokens.Bind(element, property, kind);
        }
    }

    #endregion
}
```

## When to use

`PageHeader` is the frame of a record or project page: a header with the path to the page, its title, status,
description, a meta row, actions and tabs, above the scrolling body of the selected tab. It belongs at the top of a
page, where it tells people which record they are in and what they can do to it, and it stays in reach while the body
scrolls.

- **A project or repository page in a developer tool**: "Checkout service" with its status, the Share and Follow
  actions, and tabs for Overview, Issues (with a count of open items) and Deployments.
- **An account record in a CRM or an internal admin console**: "Acme Analytics" with its status and owner in the meta
  row, and tabs for Contacts, Opportunities and Activity.
- **A billing or subscription page in a SaaS admin console**: "Acme Analytics" with a status badge, an Upgrade primary
  action, Export as a secondary action, and tabs for Invoices (with a count) and Payment methods.
- **An order detail page in e-commerce**: "Order 10482" with a "Shipped" status, a Print action and tabs for Items,
  Shipments and Payments.
- **A long record page whose body scrolls**: when the body scrolls past 16 pixels, the header folds into a compact bar
  that keeps the title and the status in view.

## When not to use

- **Moving between the sections of the app**: use `Sidebar`. The page header navigates only within one record.
- **Switching views inside a card or a panel**: use `Tabs`, which needs no page frame.
- **A dialog or a settings form with its own title**: use the title of `Dialog`, or a plain heading.
- **A single path with no tabs or actions**: use `Breadcrumb` alone, which does not reserve the height of a header.
- **A list or a table with its own toolbar**: use `FilterToolbar` above a `Table`. A page header takes its
  height from the body, so a table inside it gets less room than the page needs.

## Usage

`PageHeader` derives from `SelectingItemsControl`. Each tab is a `PageHeaderTab` item, so selection works like a list:
`SelectedIndex`, `SelectedItem` and `SelectionChanged` behave as they do on a list, and disabled tabs are skipped. Each
`PageHeaderTab` derives from `HeaderedContentControl`: `Header` is its label, `Count` an optional number, and `Content`
its body. Give the header a fixed height, or put it in a row with a height, so the body can scroll.

```xml
<arc:PageHeader Title="Checkout redesign"
                Status="On track"
                Description="Rebuilding mobile checkout around saved payment methods."
                Height="480">
    <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Overview">
        <TextBlock Text="Progress, milestones and recent activity." />
    </arc:PageHeaderTab>
    <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Issues" Count="9">
        <TextBlock Text="Open issues." />
    </arc:PageHeaderTab>
</arc:PageHeader>
```

### Anatomy

1. **Frame**: a 1 px border on the surface color with a 16 px corner radius. The header has 16 px at the top and 28 px at
   the sides (18 px at the sides below 560 px wide). The body has 28 px at the top and sides and 84 px at the bottom.
2. **Lead cell**: the breadcrumbs (`Breadcrumbs`) or, once the header condenses, the compact title (`Title`). They take
   the same place and replace each other.
3. **Action row**: the secondary `Actions` as small buttons 8 px apart, the "More actions" button (36 px square, with
   a 17 px ellipsis glyph) and the `PrimaryAction`. The row keeps 16 px from the lead cell.
4. **Title** (`Title`): the largest display size, or the next size down below 560 px wide, with 14 px between it and
   the status.
5. **Status** (`Status`, `StatusTone`): a badge with a 6 px dot, in the tone color. It also appears in the compact bar.
6. **Description** (`Description`): body text in the secondary text color, wrapped at about 60 characters.
7. **Meta** (`Meta`): any content under the description, in the extra-small muted type.
8. **Tab row**: tabs 44 px high with 10 px side padding and medium weight. `Count` sits 6 px after the label and its
   digits roll. The row runs to the frame edges, so the first label lines up with the title.
9. **Indicator**: a 2 px bar under the selected tab, inset 10 px from each side of the tab.
10. **Body**: the content of the selected tab, in the scroller under the tab row.

### Title and tabs

A header needs only a title and tabs. Without breadcrumbs, status or actions the header row stays empty until the
header condenses and shows the compact title. `Count` is an `int?`: `null` hides the number, and each change rolls the
digits to the new value.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.PageHeaderMinimalDemo">
    <arc:PageHeader Title="Billing"
                    Description="Plans, invoices and payment methods for the Northline workspace."
                    Height="380"
                    MaxWidth="800">
        <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Plan">
            <TextBlock Text="You are on the Team plan, billed yearly. The next renewal is on March 3." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
        </arc:PageHeaderTab>
        <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Invoices" Count="12">
            <TextBlock Text="Twelve invoices. The latest one is from October 1." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
        </arc:PageHeaderTab>
        <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Payment methods" Count="2">
            <TextBlock Text="Visa ending in 4242 is the default card." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
        </arc:PageHeaderTab>
    </arc:PageHeader>
</UserControl>
```

### Breadcrumbs, status and meta

`Breadcrumbs` takes the path to the page, root first, as strings, data items or `BreadcrumbItem`s. The last item is the
current page and is never a link. Choosing another crumb raises `BreadcrumbClick`, whose arguments carry the `Item` and
its `Index` (0 is the root). `Status` adds a badge with a dot beside the title, in the `StatusTone` color (success by
default). `Meta` takes any content for the row under the description, such as members, an owner and a date.

```xml
<arc:PageHeader Title="Checkout redesign" Status="At risk" StatusTone="Warning">
    <arc:PageHeader.Meta>
        <TextBlock Text="Led by Emma Collins" />
    </arc:PageHeader.Meta>
</arc:PageHeader>
```

```csharp
header.Breadcrumbs = new[] { "Northline", "Projects", "Checkout redesign" };
header.BreadcrumbClick += (_, e) => router.Open(e.Index);
```

### Actions

`Actions` are small secondary buttons in the header row. `MoreActions` always live in the "More actions" menu, after
the folded secondary actions and a separator. `PrimaryAction` is one small primary button at the end of the row, and it
shows only its icon below 460 pixels. Each `PageHeaderAction` has a `Label`, an `Icon` (a Lucide geometry such as
`ArcIcons.Bell`), and a `Command` or a `Click` event. `PageHeader.ActionInvoked` reports every action in one place,
with `IsFromMenu` set when the action came from the menu.

Use `IsDestructive="True"` on a menu action that removes data, such as a delete or a cancellation. It draws the menu
row in the danger color. `IsEnabled="False"` disables the button and dims its menu row. `IsLoading="True"` shows a
spinner and ignores clicks. `Invoke()` runs the action from code and respects those states.

When the breadcrumbs would get less than 240 pixels, the secondary actions fold into the top of the "More actions"
menu. They come back once there are 272 pixels again, so the header does not flicker at the threshold. Only the width
of the header is watched, so a label that grows (Follow to Following) never folds the button you just pressed.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             xmlns:generic="using:System.Collections.Generic"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.PageHeaderFoldingActionsDemo">
    <StackPanel Spacing="16">
        <arc:Slider x:Name="WidthSlider"
                    Label="Header width"
                    Maximum="800"
                    Minimum="360"
                    Value="800"
                    IsValueVisible="True"
                    Width="360"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" />
        <arc:PageHeader x:Name="Header"
                        Title="Design system"
                        Status="In review"
                        StatusTone="Info"
                        Width="{Binding #WidthSlider.Value}"
                        Height="300"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center">
            <arc:PageHeader.Breadcrumbs>
                <generic:List x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                    <x:String>Northline</x:String>
                    <x:String>Projects</x:String>
                    <x:String>Design system</x:String>
                </generic:List>
            </arc:PageHeader.Breadcrumbs>
            <arc:PageHeader.Actions>
                <arc:PageHeaderAction Label="Follow" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Bell}" />
                <arc:PageHeaderAction Label="Share" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Share2}" />
            </arc:PageHeader.Actions>
            <arc:PageHeader.MoreActions>
                <arc:PageHeaderAction Label="Copy link" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Link2}" />
                <arc:PageHeaderAction Label="Delete project" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Trash2}" IsDestructive="True" />
            </arc:PageHeader.MoreActions>
            <arc:PageHeader.PrimaryAction>
                <arc:PageHeaderAction Label="New component" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Plus}" />
            </arc:PageHeader.PrimaryAction>
            <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Components" Count="48">
                <TextBlock Text="Drag the slider to narrow the header. When the breadcrumbs run out of room, Follow and Share fold into the More actions menu." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            </arc:PageHeaderTab>
            <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Tokens" Count="212">
                <TextBlock Text="Colors, radii, spacing and type." TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            </arc:PageHeaderTab>
        </arc:PageHeader>
        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                   Foreground="{arc:ArcDesignTokenResource TextMuted}"
                   Text="{Binding #Header.AreActionsFolded, StringFormat='AreActionsFolded: {0}'}" />
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

Change `Label` and `Icon` to update a button in place. Set `MenuLabel` and `MenuIcon` when the menu row should read
differently.

```csharp
follow.Click += (_, _) =>
{
    following = !following;
    follow.Label = following ? "Following" : "Follow";
    follow.MenuLabel = following ? "Unfollow" : "Follow";
};
share.IsLoading = true;
```

### Condensing

When the body scrolls past 16 pixels, the header folds into a compact bar with the title and the status. It opens
again only when the body is back within 4 pixels of the top, so the header does not flicker near the threshold.
`IsCondensed` tells you the state. Choosing the compact title calls `ScrollToTop()`, which scrolls back and moves focus
to the title. The header condenses only when the body is long enough to stay scrolled once the header is smaller.

Switching tabs while the header is condensed shows the top of the new tab and keeps the compact bar. `RevealTab(index)`
does the same from code, for example after creating an item in another tab. It returns `false` for a missing or
disabled tab.

### Data items

Bind `ItemsSource` to your own items. `ItemTemplate` renders the tab label and `ContentTemplate` the body. `SelectedIndex`
and `SelectedItem` can be bound in both directions.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             xmlns:demos="using:TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.PageHeaderDataItemsDemo">
    <StackPanel Spacing="16">
        <arc:PageHeader x:Name="Header"
                        Title="Northline API"
                        Status="Healthy"
                        Height="340"
                        MaxWidth="800">
            <arc:PageHeader.ItemTemplate>
                <DataTemplate x:DataType="demos:PageHeaderDemoSection">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" />
                </DataTemplate>
            </arc:PageHeader.ItemTemplate>
            <arc:PageHeader.ContentTemplate>
                <DataTemplate x:DataType="demos:PageHeaderDemoSection">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Summary}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                </DataTemplate>
            </arc:PageHeader.ContentTemplate>
        </arc:PageHeader>
        <WrapPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center" ItemSpacing="12" LineSpacing="12">
            <arc:Button Content="Previous section" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnPreviousClick" />
            <arc:Button Content="Next section" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnNextClick" />
            <arc:Button Content="Log a new error" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Click="OnAddErrorClick" />
        </WrapPanel>
        <TextBlock HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                   Foreground="{arc:ArcDesignTokenResource TextMuted}"
                   Text="{Binding #Header.SelectedIndex, StringFormat='SelectedIndex: {0}'}" />
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Interactivity;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

/// <summary>One section of the data-bound page header demo.</summary>
public sealed class PageHeaderDemoSection
{
    public PageHeaderDemoSection(string name, int? count, string summary)
    {
        Name = name;
        Count = count;
        Summary = summary;
    }

    public string Name { get; }

    public int? Count { get; set; }

    public string Summary { get; }
}

public partial class PageHeaderDataItemsDemo : UserControl
{
    private readonly PageHeaderDemoSection[] _sections =
    [
        new("Overview", null, "Requests, latency and errors for the last 24 hours."),
        new("Endpoints", 36, "Every public route with its owner and rate limit."),
        new("Errors", 3, "Errors grouped by cause, newest first.")
    ];

    public PageHeaderDataItemsDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        // Data items get a PageHeaderTab container; its count comes from the item.
        Header.ContainerPrepared += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Container is PageHeaderTab tab && tab.Content is PageHeaderDemoSection section)
            {
                tab.Count = section.Count;
            }
        };
        Header.ItemsSource = _sections;
    }

    private void OnPreviousClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        => Header.SelectedIndex = (Header.SelectedIndex + _sections.Length - 1) % _sections.Length;

    private void OnNextClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        => Header.SelectedIndex = (Header.SelectedIndex + 1) % _sections.Length;

    // Changing a tab's count rolls its digits.
    private void OnAddErrorClick(object? sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var errors = _sections[2];
        errors.Count = (errors.Count ?? 0) + 1;
        if (Header.ContainerFromIndex(2) is PageHeaderTab tab)
        {
            tab.Count = errors.Count;
        }
    }
}
```

### Narrow widths

The layout follows the width of the control, not the window. Below 560 pixels the padding gets smaller, the root crumb
and the compact badge hide, the title steps down a size, and the far edge of the tab row fades. Below 460 pixels the
primary action shows only its icon. Until the header has been measured once, a header narrower than 720 pixels starts
with its secondary actions folded, so nothing flashes on load.

### Binding to a view model

The view model owns the selected tab, the counts and the commands. The header shows them and reports the person's
choices. With CommunityToolkit.Mvvm:

```csharp
public abstract class BillingApi
{
    public abstract Task ExportInvoicesAsync();
}

public partial class BillingPageViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private readonly BillingApi _api;

    public BillingPageViewModel(BillingApi api)
    {
        _api = api;
        ExportAction = new PageHeaderAction { Label = "Export", Icon = ArcIcons.Download, Command = ExportCommand };
    }

    public PageHeaderAction ExportAction { get; }

    [ObservableProperty]
    private int _selectedTabIndex;

    public ObservableCollection<string> Invoices { get; } = new();

    [ObservableProperty]
    private int _openInvoiceCount;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private bool _isExporting;

    [RelayCommand]
    private async Task ExportAsync()
    {
        IsExporting = true;
        try
        {
            await _api.ExportInvoicesAsync();
        }
        finally
        {
            IsExporting = false;
        }
    }
}
```

```xml
<arc:PageHeader Title="Acme Analytics"
                Status="Active"
                StatusTone="Success"
                SelectedIndex="{Binding SelectedTabIndex, Mode=TwoWay}">
    <arc:PageHeaderTab Header="Invoices" Count="{Binding OpenInvoiceCount}">
        <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Invoices}" />
    </arc:PageHeaderTab>
</arc:PageHeader>
```

- `SelectedIndex` is two-way, so the view model can move the header to a tab, and a tab change from the person updates
  the property.
- `Count` takes a binding, and its digits roll when the view model changes the value.
- A `PageHeaderAction` is not a visual, so it takes its `Command` in code, as above. Its `IsLoading` is set from the view
  model in the same way (`ExportAction.IsLoading = vm.IsExporting`, updated in a `PropertyChanged` handler), and the
  button then shows its spinner and ignores clicks.
- Use `CanExecute` on the command for actions that can be unavailable, such as an upgrade that is already applied. The
  menu row and the button follow the command's state.

### Choosing what goes in the header

The header has room for a few things, so each slot takes one kind of content:

| Slot | Put in it | Keep out of it |
|---|---|---|
| `Title` and `Status` | The record name, and one state word such as "Active" or "At risk" | Sentences, counts, dates |
| `Description` | One or two sentences about the record | Instructions for the page |
| `Meta` | Owner, members, dates and a few facts | Actions and form controls |
| `Actions` | Two or three frequent actions | Destructive actions |
| `MoreActions` | Occasional and destructive actions, such as cancel or delete | The most frequent action |
| `PrimaryAction` | The one action that moves the record forward | More than one action |

### Example: billing account page

A billing page for a SaaS workspace, with the account name and status in the title, the plan details in the meta row,
and two secondary actions. The primary action is "Upgrade plan", and the destructive cancellation sits in the menu
where it cannot be pressed by mistake. Tabs cover the account's Overview, its invoices, with a count of open invoices,
and its payment methods. The status uses the success tone for a healthy state.

![A billing account page header with breadcrumbs, a status badge, actions and an invoice tab](https://docs.tkcode.si/shots/Docs/Blocks/PageHeader/images/BillingHeader.webp)

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"

             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"

             Width="720">
```

### Content guidelines

- **Title**: the record's name, as people search for it: "Acme Analytics", "Order 10482". Avoid prefixes such as "Page:".
- **Status**: one word or two, a state rather than a sentence: "Active", "At risk", "Shipped". Pick the tone that
  matches the state, and keep Warning and Danger for states that need attention.
- **Description**: one or two sentences that say what the record is for. Write it in sentence case with a full stop.
- **Tab labels**: a noun in sentence case, such as "Invoices" or "Payment methods". Counts are numbers only.
- **Actions**: verb and object in sentence case: "Export invoices", "Upgrade plan". Use the menu for actions that
  are rare or destructive, and say what they remove.

| Instead of | Write |
|---|---|
| Page: Billing settings | Acme Analytics |
| Status: this record is currently in good standing | Active |
| EXPORT | Export |
| Delete everything | Cancel subscription |
| Invoices (2 unpaid!) | Invoices, with the count of open invoices |

### Best practices

**Do**

- Keep the header height fixed, or give it a row with a height. The body scrolls inside it, and the condensing logic
  depends on that height to decide whether the header can fold.
- Put the destructive actions in `MoreActions`. The menu asks for one more step, so a cancellation is not one click
  away from a frequent action.
- Bind `SelectedIndex` two-way when the view model needs to know or change the tab, so a deep link can open a tab.
- Use `RevealTab(index)` after creating an item in another tab. The new item is then visible without the header
  leaving its compact state.
- Give each action a short `Label`. The label is the button text on wide headers and the accessible name below 460
  pixels, where the primary action shows only its icon.

**Avoid**

- Putting form controls in `Meta`. The meta row is extra-small muted text, so an input there is hard to read and to
  use with a keyboard.
- Calling `ScrollToTop()` on every tab change. It moves focus to the title, which takes focus away from the content the
  person is using.
- Setting `IsLoading` on several actions at once. One spinner says what is loading; several spinners suggest the page
  is stuck.
- Using a count on every tab. A count tells people how many items are waiting; on a tab that only shows a document,
  it is noise.
- Making the header so tall that the body cannot scroll past the condensed viewport. A short body keeps the full
  header, so the page never folds and the title stays large.

### Common questions

**Why did my secondary actions move into the "More actions" menu?** The header folds them when the breadcrumbs would get
less than 240 pixels, and it brings them back at 272 pixels. Shorten the breadcrumb labels, move the least used actions
to `MoreActions`, or widen the header. `AreActionsFolded` tells you the current state.

**Why does the header not condense when I scroll?** The header condenses only when the body is tall enough to stay
scrolled past the expand line once the header is smaller. A short body keeps the full header, so the page does not
jump. Give the body content that is taller than the condensed viewport, or leave the header expanded.

**How do I open a specific tab from a link?** Set `SelectedIndex` to the tab's index, or call `RevealTab(index)` when the
header is already condensed and the body should start at the top of the new tab. `RevealTab` returns `false` when the
index is missing or the tab is disabled.

**Can a disabled tab be selected with the arrow keys?** No. Disabled tabs are skipped by the arrow keys and by Home and
End, so the selection moves to the next enabled tab.

**Does the header keep the compact title when I switch tabs?** Yes. Switching tabs while condensed shows the top of the
new tab and keeps the compact bar. Choosing a tab does not expand the header.

## API reference

### PageHeader

The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | `string?` | `null` | The page title: the large heading, and the compact bar's title once the header condenses. |
| `Description` | `string?` | `null` | One or two sentences under the title (wraps at about 60 characters). |
| `Status` | `string?` | `null` | Status shown as a badge with a dot beside the title and in the compact bar; null hides it. |
| `StatusTone` | `BadgeTone` | `Success` | Tone of the status badge (default `Success`). |
| `Breadcrumbs` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The path to this page, root first; the last item is the current page. Strings, data items or `BreadcrumbItem`s, shown by a `Breadcrumb`. Choosing one raises `BreadcrumbClick`. |
| `Meta` | `object?` | `null` | Meta row under the description (members, owner, dates): any content, drawn in the extra-small muted type. |
| `PrimaryAction` | `PageHeaderAction?` | `null` | The main action: a small primary button at the end of the header row (icon only below 460px). |
| `ContentTemplate` | `IDataTemplate?` | `null` | Template for the body of data items (the tab label uses `ItemTemplate`). |
| `MoreActionsLabel` | `string` | `"More actions"` | Accessible name of the overflow button (default "More actions"). |
| `BackToTopLabel` | `string` | `"back to top"` | Added to the title in the accessible name of the compact bar (default "back to top"). |
| `TabsLabel` | `string` | `"Sections"` | Accessible name of the tab row (default "Sections"). |
| `IsCondensed` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True while the header is folded into the compact bar (the body scrolled past 16px, until it is back within 4px). |
| `AreActionsFolded` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True while the secondary `Actions` are folded into the "More actions" menu. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BreadcrumbClick` | `PageHeaderBreadcrumbClickEventArgs` | Raised when a breadcrumb is chosen (the current page is not a link). |
| `ActionInvoked` | `PageHeaderActionEventArgs` | Raised when an action is chosen from its button or the "More actions" menu. |

Pseudo-classes: `:condensed`, `:actions-folded`, `:narrow`, `:tight`

Derives from `SelectingItemsControl`: every member of `SelectingItemsControl` works as well.

### PageHeaderTab

One tab of a `PageHeader`: `Header` is the label in the tab row, `Count` an optional number beside it that rolls digit by digit when it changes, and `Content` the page body shown in the header's scroller while the tab is selected.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IsSelected` | `bool` | `false` | Whether this tab is the selected one. |
| `Count` | `int?` | `null` | Number shown after the label (open issues, files); null shows none. Changes roll the digits. |

Pseudo-classes: `:selected`, `:pressed`, `:has-count`

Derives from `HeaderedContentControl`: every member of `HeaderedContentControl` works as well.

### PageHeaderAction

One action of a `PageHeader`: a button in the header row (`Actions`, `PrimaryAction`) or a row of its "More actions" menu (`MoreActions`, and the secondary actions once they fold away). Changing `Label` or `Icon` swaps the button content in place (Follow becomes Following) while the button width springs to fit.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string?` | `null` | Button text, and the accessible name of the button and its menu row. |
| `Icon` | `object?` | `null` | Leading icon: a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry` (drawn as a 16px glyph) or a control (button only). |
| `MenuLabel` | `string?` | `null` | Text of the menu row when it differs from the button (Arc: "Following" on the button, "Unfollow" in the menu). |
| `MenuIcon` | `object?` | `null` | Icon of the menu row when it differs from the button; falls back to a `Geometry``Icon`. |
| `Command` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Command run when the action is chosen. |
| `CommandParameter` | `object?` | `null` | Parameter passed to `Command`. |
| `IsEnabled` | `bool` | `true` | False disables the button and dims the menu row. Defaults to true. |
| `IsLoading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the button spinner and ignores clicks while true; the menu row is disabled meanwhile. |
| `IsDestructive` | `bool` | `false` | Draws the menu row in the danger color (destructive actions in `MoreActions`). |
| `Tag` | `object?` | `null` | Free application data (for example an id to tell actions apart in one handler). |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Click` | `EventHandler?` | Raised when the action is chosen from its button or its menu row (before `Command` runs). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

## Accessibility

- The control is a region named by `Title`. The title is a level 2 heading.
- The breadcrumbs are a navigation landmark. The current page is marked and is not a link.
- The tab row is named by `TabsLabel`. Left and Right move between tabs and select them, looping at the ends. Home and
  End go to the first and last tab. Only the selected tab is in the Tab order.
- The overflow button is named by `MoreActionsLabel`. The menu supports the arrow keys, Home, End, typing to jump,
  Enter, and Escape to close and return focus.
- The compact title is named "Title, back to top" (`BackToTopLabel`). Hidden parts of the header leave the Tab order
  and ignore the pointer.
- Below 460 pixels the primary button keeps its label as its accessible name.

### Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Left` / `Right` on a tab | Selects the previous or next enabled tab; the selection loops at the ends |
| `Home` / `End` on a tab | Selects the first or last enabled tab |
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Enters or leaves the tab row; only the selected tab is a stop |
| `Enter` on "More actions" | Opens the menu; the arrow keys move between its rows |
| `Escape` in the menu | Closes the menu and returns focus to its button |
| `Enter` on a breadcrumb | Raises `BreadcrumbClick` with the item and its index |
| `Enter` on the compact title | Scrolls to the top and moves focus to the title |

## Motion

- Condensing: the intro closes its height on a smooth spring. The title shrinks to 62% toward its top left corner and
  fades with a slight blur. The breadcrumbs lift away and the compact title rises in from a soft blur.
- Folding actions: the secondary actions close their width on a smooth spring and fade. Only the right edge is clipped,
  so they fold under the overflow button.
- Tabs: the indicator glides between tabs on a morph spring. Counts roll digit by digit. The new body slides in 12
  pixels from the side of travel while the old one fades out.
- Reduced motion keeps only the fades. Heights and widths change at once and the body crossfades. Off applies every
  change at once.

| Change | Full | Reduced | Off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Header condenses or expands | Intro closes on a smooth spring; the title shrinks and fades | Heights change at once; the title and breadcrumbs fade | Immediate |
| Compact title appears | Rises from a soft blur | Fades | Immediate |
| Secondary actions fold | Width closes on a smooth spring, clipped at the right edge | Width changes at once | Immediate |
| Tab changes | Body slides 12 px from the side of travel; the old body fades out | Body crossfades | Immediate |

## Related

- `Breadcrumb` for a path on its own.
- `Tabs` for views inside a card or a panel.
- `Badge` for status labels.
- `DropdownMenu` for menus of actions.

| Component | Choose it when |
|---|---|
| `Sidebar` | People move between the sections of the whole app |
| `Tabs` | The views sit inside a card or a panel, without a page frame |
| `Breadcrumb` | Only the path is needed, with no tabs or actions |
| `Dialog` | The title and actions belong to a task that interrupts the page |
| `FilterToolbar` | A table or list needs its own filters above the rows |
| `DropdownMenu` | A menu of actions appears from a button elsewhere on the page |

# Command palette

> A complete keyboard driven action surface with search, grouped results, and shortcuts.

- Package: `TKCode.Arc.Blocks`, `dotnet add package TKCode.Arc.Blocks --version 0.3.2-preview.1`
- XAML namespace: `xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"`
- Live page: https://docs.tkcode.si/blocks/command-palette

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.CommandPalettePreviewDemo">
    <!-- The panel keeps the palette on this stage: a non-modal dialog needs no scrim, and an app would not need the panel. -->
    <arc:ArcOverlayHost Height="480">
        <StackPanel Spacing="12" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
            <arc:Button Content="Open command palette"
                        Variant="Secondary"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        arc:CommandPaletteDialog.Opens="{Binding #Palette}" />
            <TextBlock x:Name="Hint"
                       FontSize="14"
                       TextAlignment="Center"
                       HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                       Foreground="{arc:ArcDesignTokenResource TextMuted}" />
            <TextBlock x:Name="LastCommand"
                       Text="Nothing run yet."
                       FontSize="14"
                       TextAlignment="Center"
                       HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                       Foreground="{arc:ArcDesignTokenResource TextSecondary}" />
        </StackPanel>
        <arc:CommandPaletteDialog x:Name="Palette"
                                  IsOpen="True"
                                  IsModal="False"
                                  PanelWidth="480"
                                  PlaceholderText="Search board commands"
                                  ItemSelected="OnItemSelected">
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="add-task" Group="Tasks" Label="Add a task" Description="Put a new task on the board" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Plus}" Shortcut="N" />
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="assign" Group="Tasks" Label="Assign to me" Description="Take ownership of the selected task" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.User}" Shortcut="A" />
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="due" Group="Tasks" Label="Set a due date" Description="Pick a deadline from the calendar" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.CalendarDays}" />
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="labels" Group="Board" Label="Group by label" Description="Sort the board into label columns" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Tag}" Shortcut="L" />
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="invite" Group="Board" Label="Invite a teammate" Description="Send an invitation by email" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Users}" Shortcut="I" />
            <arc:CommandPaletteItem Id="delete" Group="Danger zone" Label="Delete this board" Description="Remove it with all of its tasks" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Trash2}" Keywords="remove" />
        </arc:CommandPaletteDialog>
    </arc:ArcOverlayHost>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class CommandPalettePreviewDemo : UserControl
{
    public CommandPalettePreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Hint.Text = OperatingSystem.IsMacOS() ? "⌘ K to open, Esc to close" : "Ctrl K to open, Esc to close";
    }

    private void OnItemSelected(object? sender, CommandPaletteItemSelectedEventArgs e)
        => LastCommand.Text = $"Last command: {e.Item.Label}";
```
