### Other words

Every visible and announced text is in `Labels`, a `RolesPermissionsLabels` object with English defaults: the subtitle
format, "1 person" and "{0} people", the menu rows, the copy names, the legends, the review bar's words and formats,
the screen reader names and every announcement. Replace it with an object initializer that sets only what changes.

## API reference

### RolesPermissions

A workspace's roles × permissions matrix. Columns are roles, rows are permissions in collapsible groups; each cell is a switch and each group row has one tri-state checkbox per role that switches the whole group (the changed cells ripple one after another). Locked roles (the owner) always have everything. Changes are not applied at once: changed cells and their role headers get an unsaved dot, and a review bar slides up with the count, the roles they touch and the people they reach, Discard and Save. Save awaits `SaveHandler` with a spinner, reads "saved" for a moment and closes; a failed save keeps the changes and offers to try again. Each role header opens a menu to copy the role (inserted on its right as a new role), undo its edits, or remove a new role.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | `string?` | `"Roles & access"` | The heading. |
| `WorkspaceName` | `string?` | `null` | The workspace named in the subtitle ("Northwind Studio · 31 people in 5 roles"); null leaves it out. |
| `MemberCount` | `int?` | `null` | The member count in the subtitle; null counts the members shown in the header. |
| `MembersSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The workspace members shown as avatars in the header (`AvatarGroupMember`, names, ...), when you give them as a list; it wins over `Members`. |
| `RolesSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The roles (columns), when you give them as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Roles`. |
| `GroupsSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The permission groups (rows), when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Groups`. |
| `SavedGrants` | `IReadOnlySet<RolesPermissionsGrant>?` | `null` | The saved grants: the baseline unsaved dots compare against. A successful save writes the new baseline back (two-way). Locked roles need no grants. |
| `Grants` | `IReadOnlySet<RolesPermissionsGrant>?` | `null` | The current grants, saved or not (two-way: every change writes a new set). Null starts from `SavedGrants`. |
| `SaveHandler` | `Func<RolesPermissionsSaveRequest, CancellationToken, Task>?` | `null` | Stores the changes: awaited when Save is pressed (or `SaveAsync` is called) with what to save and a token that `CancelSave` or the block leaving the window cancels. While it runs the matrix takes no changes. An exception keeps the changes and shows the failure; a cancellation returns to the review bar quietly. Null saves at once. |
| `SavedHoldDuration` | `TimeSpan?` | `null` | How long the review bar reads "saved" before it closes; null uses the token's 1.6 s. |
| `ErrorFormatter` | `Func<Exception, string>?` | `null` | Turns a failed save's exception into the bar's second line; null shows the exception's message. |
| `IsRoleMenuEnabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the role headers open their menu (copy, undo edits, remove). |
| `CanDuplicateRoles` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the role menu offers to copy a role. |
| `IsFooterVisible` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the footer with the two legends shows. |
| `IsFramed` | `bool` | `true` | Draws a bordered card with radius 16 (true); false lays the block flat with a page margin (16–32 by width). |
| `Labels` | `RolesPermissionsLabels` | – | Every word the block shows or announces. |
| `PendingChangeCount` | `int` | – | *Read-only.* The number the review bar shows: one per changed cell, plus one per new role. |
| `HasUnsavedChanges` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True while there is anything to save. |
| `SaveState` | `RolesPermissionsSaveState` | – | *Read-only.* Where the save stands. |
| `ErrorText` | `string?` | – | *Read-only.* The last failed save's error line; null unless `SaveState` is Failed. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GrantChanged` | `RolesPermissionsGrantChangedEventArgs` | Raised for every cell that changes value, by the person or by code. |
| `GroupToggled` | `RolesPermissionsGroupToggledEventArgs` | Raised when a group checkbox switched a group for a role (after the cells' `GrantChanged`). |
| `RoleDuplicated` | `RolesPermissionsRoleDuplicatedEventArgs` | Raised when a role was copied. |
| `RoleDeleted` | `RolesPermissionsRoleDeletedEventArgs` | Raised when a new role was removed (its menu, or Discard). |
| `ChangesReverted` | `RolesPermissionsRevertedEventArgs` | Raised when a role's edits were undone, or every change was discarded. |
| `SaveStarting` | `RolesPermissionsSaveStartingEventArgs` | Raised before a save runs; set `Cancel` to keep it from starting. |
| `Saved` | `RolesPermissionsSavedEventArgs` | Raised when the save handler finished without an error. |
| `SaveFailed` | `RolesPermissionsSaveFailedEventArgs` | Raised when the save handler threw. |

Pseudo-classes: `:framed`, `:narrow`, `:compact`, `:dirty`, `:saving`, `:saved`, `:failed`, `:scrolled`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsRole

One role of a `RolesPermissions` matrix: a column with its name, how many people hold it and a line for the header's menu. A locked role (the workspace owner) always has every permission: its cells show a muted check and cannot be changed. Roles the person duplicates in the block are new (`IsNew`) until the changes are saved.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Key` | `string` | `""` | The stable id grants refer to (`RoleKey`); it must be unique in the matrix. |
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The role's name: the column header and the menu's title. |
| `MemberCount` | `int` | `0` | How many people hold the role: the header's second line ("4 people") and the reach in the review bar. |
| `Description` | `string?` | `null` | The line under the name in the header's menu (who holds it); null shows the member count. |
| `IsLocked` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the role always has every permission (a lock leads its name and its cells cannot change). |
| `IsNew` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True for a role duplicated in the block and not saved yet; it reads "New role" and can be deleted. |
| `Tag` | `object?` | `null` | Any object the app wants to keep with the role. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsGroup

A group of permissions in a `RolesPermissions` matrix: a row with a disclosure button and one "whole group" checkbox per role (on when every permission of the group is on, mixed when some are), followed by its permissions.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Key` | `string?` | `null` | A stable id the app can match the group by (events); null when it has none. |
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The group's name. |
| `IsExpanded` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the group's permissions are shown (two-way: the disclosure button writes it back). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsItem

One permission of a `RolesPermissionsGroup`: a row with one switch per role.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Key` | `string` | `""` | The stable id grants refer to (`PermissionKey`); unique in the matrix. |
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The permission's name: the row's label, also read in the switches' names ("Manager: Send invitations"). |
| `Description` | `string?` | `null` | A longer explanation, read as the row's switches' help text; null leaves it out. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsGrant

One granted permission: the role `RoleKey` may do `PermissionKey`.

Derives from `ValueType`: every member of `ValueType` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsSaveRequest

What a save of a `RolesPermissions` matrix carries: passed to `SaveHandler` and the save events. Everything is a snapshot taken when the save started.

### RolesPermissionsSaveState

Where the save of a `RolesPermissions` matrix stands.

Derives from `Enum`: every member of `Enum` works as well.

### RolesPermissionsLabels

Every word `RolesPermissions` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance (an object initializer that sets only what changes) to translate or reword. Formats use `{0}`, `{1}` placeholders; a malformed format shows as written instead of throwing.

## Accessibility

- The matrix is one **Tab** stop. It starts on the first role header and remembers the last part the person worked on;
  **Tab** then moves on to the review bar's buttons.
- **Left** and **Right** move along a row and stop at its ends; on a group row, **Left** from the first checkbox reaches
  the group's button.
- **Up** and **Down** move to the row above or below in the same column, snapping to the nearest column when the row has
  none there (from a group button down to the first role); folded rows are skipped.
- **Home** and **End** go to the first and last part of the row; **Ctrl+Home** and **Ctrl+End** to the first role header
  and the last cell of the matrix.
- **Space** or **Enter** switches a cell, folds a group, or opens a role's menu. **Escape** closes the menu and returns
  to its header.
- After Save and Discard the focus goes back to the last cell worked on; after a copy to the new role's header; after
  Remove role to the header on the left.
- The matrix is a data grid named by the title. Group checkboxes are tri-state checkboxes named "Lead: all Team
  permissions"; permission cells are switches named "Lead: Send invitations". Locked cells add ", always on"; unsaved
  cells add ", unsaved".
- A role header is a button with a menu, named by the role and its member count, plus ", permissions are fixed" for a
  locked role and ", unsaved changes" when it has changes. A group button reports whether it is expanded.
- Every switch, group toggle, copy, removal, undo, discard and save is announced politely in a sentence; a failed save
  is announced assertively. The review bar is a region named "Unsaved changes".
- The header's avatars are one group named "Workspace members".
- Hover is never needed: the column band and the row tint follow the keyboard focus as well as the pointer.

## Motion

- **Cells**: the box fills in 160 ms and the check draws itself in about 100 ms. The unsaved dot pops from 0.3 on a quick
  spring. A pointer press presses the box to 0.88 and lets it back on the CSS spring. Group checkboxes ripple their cells
  60 ms apart; Discard and Undo edits ripple 30 ms per row down the whole matrix; a save clears every dot at once.
- **Locked cells** shake sideways (3, −2, 1 px) over 330 ms.
- **Column band**: fades in over 160 ms on the hovered or focused role and slides between roles on the smooth spring.
  The hovered row tints in 120 ms, its sticky label too.
- **Groups** fold and unfold on the smooth spring with a short fade; the chevron turns on a slightly bouncy spring.
- **Copies** open their column from zero width on the smooth spring as they fade in; a removed role fades and closes.
- **Review bar**: its space opens in 240 ms while the bar rises from 24 px below on the smooth spring and fades in. The
  count rolls, "change" and "changes" morph letter by letter, and the second line swaps with a short blur. The Save
  button spins while saving, then morphs to "Saved" as its width springs.
- Reduced motion and Off apply every change at once, as Arc's reduced mode does.

## Related

- `Team members`, `Invite people` and `Team directory`, the other People blocks.
- `Settings page` for a page of independent switches with a save bar.
- `Checkbox` and `Switch` for single controls of the same look.
- `DropdownMenu` and `AvatarGroup`, used by the role headers and the header.

# Profile page

> A person's profile as one page: a cover and avatar, an about column with stats, Activity and Projects tabs, and an edit sheet whose saved fields glow once.

- Package: `TKCode.Arc.Blocks`, `dotnet add package TKCode.Arc.Blocks --version 0.3.2-preview.1`
- XAML namespace: `xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"`
- Live page: https://docs.tkcode.si/blocks/profile-page

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ProfilePagePreviewDemo">
    <!-- A framed page 760 high that scrolls inside; Edit profile saves after a simulated 700ms. Data: ProfilePageDemoData. -->
    <arc:ProfilePage x:Name="Page" Margin="0,12" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ProfilePagePreviewDemo : UserControl
{
    public ProfilePagePreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ProfilePageDemoData.Fill(Page);
    }
}
```

## When to use

`ProfilePage` is the screen a person lands on when they open their own profile or someone else's. A wide cover sits on top
with the round avatar riding its bottom edge; the name, handle and headline follow, with Share and Edit profile on the
right. Underneath, a narrow about column holds the bio, the location, the website, when the person joined and up to three
numbers, and two tabs fill the rest: Activity, a grouped list of what the person did recently, and Projects, a grid of
cards that visitors can star.

Edit profile slides a sheet in from the right inside the block. It edits the name, headline, location, website and bio,
checks them, and on save writes the new values back to the page, where each field that changed glows once so the reader
sees what moved.

- **A member's own profile in a product.** People see what others see and fix their details in place, without a separate
  settings page.
- **A team member's page.** Turn editing off (`IsEditable="False"`) and the same layout becomes a read-only page about a
  colleague, with their recent work and projects.
- **A creator or portfolio page.** The project cards carry a cover, the collaborators and a star count, enough for a
  public showcase.

## When not to use

- **Account settings.** Passwords, security, notifications and billing belong in `SettingsPage`, `SecuritySettings` and
  `BillingOverview`. This block edits only the public details.
- **Many people at once.** Use the Team directory block or a table to browse or search a team; this block is about one person.
- **A marketing team section.** A landing page that introduces a team needs portraits and short bios in a grid, not tabs
  and an edit sheet.
- **Long feeds.** The Activity tab is a short summary (a handful of rows per group). Use a timeline or a paged list for an
  endless history.

## Usage

The block derives from Avalonia's `TemplatedControl`. Give it a `ProfileDetails` and fill the three collections; the
portraits and covers are yours (the block shows initials when there is no portrait, and the muted surface or your
`CoverBrush` when there is no cover).

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc">
    <arc:ProfilePage ProfileUrl="https://fieldnote.app/@rowan">
        <arc:ProfilePage.Profile>
            <arc:ProfileDetails Name="Rowan Ellery"
                                Handle="rowan"
                                Headline="Product designer at Fieldnote"
                                Location="Bergen, Norway"
                                Website="rowanellery.studio"
                                JoinedText="June 2020"
                                Bio="I design tools for field researchers and care about honest defaults and quiet motion." />
        </arc:ProfilePage.Profile>
        <arc:ProfilePage.Stats>
            <arc:ProfileStat Label="Followers" Value="3107" />
            <arc:ProfileStat Label="Following" Value="212" />
            <arc:ProfileStat Label="Shipped" Value="41" />
        </arc:ProfilePage.Stats>
        <arc:ProfilePage.Activity>
            <arc:ProfileActivity Kind="Shipped" Action="shipped" Target="Color tokens v3" TimeText="3h"
                                 Group="This week" Detail="New contrast pairs for charts and a calmer dark palette." />
            <arc:ProfileActivity Kind="Reviewed" Action="approved" Target="Compact table mode" TimeText="Wed" Group="This week" />
        </arc:ProfilePage.Activity>
    </arc:ProfilePage>
</UserControl>
```

### Anatomy

- **Cover**: 240 high on a wide page (200 below 1000, 128 below 640). `ProfileDetails.Cover` is drawn over
  `ProfileDetails.CoverBrush`.
- **Identity**: the 104 avatar with a 4px ring in the surface color, half over the cover; Share and Edit profile on the
  right; the name (28px display type) and "@handle · headline" under it.
- **About**: the bio as one paragraph, then location, website (a link that opens in the browser) and "Joined …", each line
  hidden while its value is empty, then the stats in three equal columns under a hairline.
- **Tabs**: Activity and Projects with their counts; a 2px underline marks the chosen one. Below 760 the about block moves
  above the tabs.
- **Edit sheet**: 420 wide on the right of the block, over a scrim; it covers the visible part of the block wherever the
  page is scrolled. Below 420 it spans the block.

### Activity

Each `ProfileActivity` reads "{first name} {Action} **{Target}**", with an optional `Detail` line and a `TimeText` at the
end. The first name is the first word of `ProfileDetails.Name`, so the rows follow a rename. Rows are grouped under their
`Group` heading in the order the groups first appear. `Kind` picks the icon: a green rocket for `Shipped`, an amber star
for `Starred`, and muted icons for `Commented`, `Created` and `Reviewed`.

### Projects and stars

Each `ProfileProject` is a card with a 96px cover, the title and `Visibility` (Public or Private), a description, its
`Collaborators` as overlapping faces, `UpdatedText` and a star button. Pressing the star toggles `IsStarred` and changes
`StarCount` by one on the item itself (both are two-way), then raises `StarChanged` with the project, the new state and
the count, so your code can tell the server. Cards sit in two columns, one below 560.

### Controlling the tab

`Tab` is two-way. Bind it to keep the tab in your own state (for example in the address), or set it from other buttons;
`TabChanged` reports every change with the old and new tab, whether it came from a tab, the arrow keys or a binding.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ProfilePageControlledTabDemo">
    <!-- The tab is bound both ways: the buttons set it, the page's own tabs and arrow keys report it. -->
    <StackPanel Spacing="12" Margin="0,12">
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8" HorizontalAlignment="Center">
            <arc:Button x:Name="ShowActivity" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Content="Show activity" />
            <arc:Button x:Name="ShowProjects" Variant="Secondary" Size="Small" Content="Show projects" />
        </StackPanel>
        <arc:ProfilePage x:Name="Page" PageHeight="620" />
        <TextBlock x:Name="Log" HorizontalAlignment="Center" TextAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap" MaxWidth="560" />
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ProfilePageControlledTabDemo : UserControl
{
    public ProfilePageControlledTabDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ProfilePageDemoData.Fill(Page);
        ShowActivity.Click += (_, _) => Page.Tab = ProfilePageTab.Activity;
        ShowProjects.Click += (_, _) => Page.Tab = ProfilePageTab.Projects;

        Page.TabChanged += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"TabChanged: {e.OldTab} → {e.NewTab}";
        Page.StarChanged += (_, e) =>
            Log.Text = $"StarChanged: {e.Project.Title} {(e.IsStarred ? "starred" : "unstarred")} · {e.StarCount:N0} stars";
        Page.Shared += (_, e) => Log.Text = e.Succeeded ? $"Shared: copied {e.Url}" : "Shared: the clipboard refused the link";
        Page.Saved += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Saved: {(e.ChangedFields == ProfileFields.None ? "nothing changed" : e.ChangedFields.ToString())}";
    }
}
```

### Saving

`SaveHandler` receives the edited `ProfileDetails` (trimmed, with the handle, pictures and joined text carried over) and
returns a task. While it runs the Save button shows a spinner and "Saving"; the fields, Cancel and the close button stay
usable. When it completes, `Profile` is replaced by the new object, the sheet closes, each field whose trimmed value
changed glows once and `Saved` reports the previous profile, the new one and `ChangedFields`. Without a handler the block
simulates a save that succeeds after `SimulatedSaveDelay` (700ms).

Throw from the handler to keep the sheet open: the exception's message appears in a red strip above the sheet's buttons,
is announced, and `SaveFailed` is raised. The draft stays as it was, so the person can try again.

```csharp
var http = new HttpClient();
page.SaveHandler = async profile =>
{
    var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { profile.Name, profile.Headline, profile.Location, profile.Website, profile.Bio });
    var body = new StringContent(json, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
    var response = await http.PutAsync("https://api.example.com/me", body);
    if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
    {
        throw new InvalidOperationException("We could not save your profile. Try again in a moment.");
    }
};
```

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ProfilePageSaveErrorDemo">
    <!-- The save handler fails the first time and succeeds on the retry; the clipboard refuses the link. -->
    <StackPanel Spacing="12" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:ProfilePage x:Name="Page" PageHeight="640" />
        <TextBlock x:Name="Log" HorizontalAlignment="Center" TextAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap" MaxWidth="560"
                   Text="Edit a field and save: the first try fails, the second one goes through." />
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ProfilePageSaveErrorDemo : UserControl
{
    private int _attempts;

    public ProfilePageSaveErrorDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ProfilePageDemoData.Fill(Page);

        // Your server call goes here. Throwing keeps the sheet open and shows the message above its buttons.
        Page.SaveHandler = async profile =>
        {
            await Task.Delay(900);
            if (++_attempts == 1)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("We could not reach the server. Your changes are still here; try again.");
            }
        };
        // A clipboard that refuses: Share shows Failed for a moment.
        Page.CopyHandler = _ => Task.FromResult(false);

        Page.SaveFailed += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"SaveFailed: {e.Error.Message}";
        Page.Saved += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Saved on attempt {_attempts}: {e.ChangedFields}";
        Page.Shared += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Shared: {(e.Succeeded ? "copied" : "failed")}";
    }
}
```

Closing the sheet while a save runs does not cancel it: the values are written back when it completes, and a failure is
announced and reported through `SaveFailed`.

### Rules in the sheet

- **Name** is required: it must contain something other than spaces.
- **Website** is optional. When filled, it must look like a web address: an optional lower-case `http://` or `https://`,
  at least two dot-separated parts of letters, digits, `-` or `_` (no port), and an optional path that starts with `/`
  and has no spaces. `example.com`, `www.example.com/work` and `https://example.com/p?q=1` pass; `example`,
  `localhost:3000` and `ftp://example.com` do not.
- **Bio** stops at `BioMaxLength` characters (200); the counter beside its label shows how many are left.

Errors stay hidden until the first save attempt and then follow every keystroke. Save is disabled until the draft differs
from the profile.

### Share

Share copies `ProfileUrl` (or "https://example.com/@{handle}" when it is not set) and the button reads Copied or Failed for
`ShareFeedbackDuration` (1800ms) without changing width. `CopyHandler` replaces the system clipboard, for example to add
tracking or to test the failure; returning false or throwing shows Failed. `Shared` reports the result.

### Read-only profiles

With `IsEditable="False"` the Edit profile button is gone and `OpenEditor` does nothing; everything else, Share and the
stars included, still works.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ProfilePageReadOnlyDemo">
    <!-- Someone else's profile: no Edit profile, Projects first; Share still copies the link. -->
    <arc:ProfilePage x:Name="Page" Margin="0,12" IsEditable="False" Tab="Projects" PageHeight="640" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ProfilePageReadOnlyDemo : UserControl
{
    public ProfilePageReadOnlyDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Page.Profile = ProfilePageDemoData.Colleague();
        Page.ProfileUrl = "https://fieldnote.app/@imani";
        Page.Stats.AddRange([new ProfileStat("Followers", 1284), new ProfileStat("Following", 96), new ProfileStat("Studies", 27)]);
        Page.Activity.AddRange(ProfilePageDemoData.Activity().Take(3));
        Page.Projects.AddRange(ProfilePageDemoData.Projects().Skip(1).Take(2));
    }
}
```

### Narrow containers and height

The layout follows the block's own width, not the window's: the cover shrinks below 1000, the columns stack below 760, the
header tightens below 640 (a 128 cover, an 84 avatar and a 22px name), the cards go to one column below 560 and the sheet's
Location and Website fields stack below 420. The block is `PageHeight` tall (760) or less when its parent offers less, and
scrolls inside. `IsFramed="False"` removes the border and the rounded corners for a full-window page.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ProfilePageNarrowDemo">
    <!-- 390 wide: one column, a 128 cover, cards in one column; the sheet spans the page and stacks Location and Website. -->
    <arc:ProfilePage x:Name="Page" Width="390" PageHeight="700" Margin="0,12" HorizontalAlignment="Center" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ProfilePageNarrowDemo : UserControl
{
    public ProfilePageNarrowDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ProfilePageDemoData.Fill(Page);
    }
}
```

### Texts

Every word the block shows or announces is in `Labels`, a `ProfilePageLabels` object with English defaults. Replace the
whole object to translate it; texts that include values (the bio counter, "Joined …", the star button names) are
functions so the word order can change.

## API reference

### ProfilePage

A person's profile page as one block: a wide cover with the avatar riding its bottom edge, the name, handle and headline, Share and Edit profile; an about column (bio, location, website, joined date and up to three stats) beside two tabs, Activity (grouped rows) and Projects (cards with stars). Edit profile slides a sheet in from the right inside the block; saving writes the new values back and makes each changed field glow once. The block is `PageHeight` tall (760, or less when less space is available) and scrolls inside; the sheet always covers the visible part. Its layout follows its own width: the cover shrinks below 1000, the columns stack below 760, the header tightens below 640, the cards go to one column below 560 and the sheet's paired fields stack below 420.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Profile` | `ProfileDetails?` | `null` | The person shown. A successful save replaces it with a new object holding the trimmed values. |
| `Stats` | `AvaloniaList<ProfileStat>` | `null` | The numbers under the bio, when no `StatsSource` is set (up to three are shown). |
| `StatsSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | A collection of `ProfileStat` you own; wins over `Stats` and is followed when it notifies. |
| `Activity` | `AvaloniaList<ProfileActivity>` | `null` | The Activity rows, when no `ActivitySource` is set. |
| `ActivitySource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | A collection of `ProfileActivity` you own; wins over `Activity`. |
| `Projects` | `AvaloniaList<ProfileProject>` | `null` | The project cards, when no `ProjectsSource` is set. |
| `ProjectsSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | A collection of `ProfileProject` you own; wins over `Projects`. |
| `Tab` | `ProfilePageTab` | `Activity` | The tab shown (two-way; default Activity). Bind it to control the tabs from outside. |
| `IsEditable` | `bool` | `true` | Whether Edit profile is offered (default true). False makes the page read-only, as for someone else's profile. |
| `IsEditing` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the edit sheet is open (two-way). Setting it opens or closes the sheet. |
| `ProfileUrl` | `string?` | `null` | The link Share copies; null copies "https://example.com/@{handle}". |
| `SaveHandler` | `Func<ProfileDetails, Task>?` | `null` | Saves the edited profile (it receives the trimmed draft). Throw to keep the sheet open: the exception's message is shown above the sheet's buttons. Null simulates a save that succeeds after `SimulatedSaveDelay`. |
| `SimulatedSaveDelay` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:00.7000000` | How long the simulated save takes when no `SaveHandler` is set (default 700ms). |
| `CopyHandler` | `Func<string, Task<bool>>?` | `null` | Copies the link (returns whether it worked; throwing counts as a failure). Null uses the system clipboard. |
| `ShareFeedbackDuration` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:01.8000000` | How long Share shows Copied or Failed before it reads Share again (default 1800ms). |
| `BioMaxLength` | `int` | `200` | The most characters the bio field takes (default 200); the counter shows what is left. |
| `PageHeight` | `double` | `760` | The block's height when there is room (default 760); with less space it takes what it gets and scrolls inside. |
| `IsFramed` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the block has a 1px border and rounded corners (default true); false for a full-window page. |
| `Labels` | `ProfilePageLabels` | – | Every word the block shows or announces. Replace the whole object to translate it. |
| `IsSaving` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* Whether a save is running. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TabChanged` | `ProfilePageTabChangedEventArgs` | Raised when `Tab` changes (by a tab, the arrow keys or a binding). |
| `StarChanged` | `ProfileStarChangedEventArgs` | Raised when a project's star is pressed, after its count and state were updated. |
| `Saved` | `ProfileSavedEventArgs` | Raised after a successful save, once `Profile` holds the new values. |
| `SaveFailed` | `ProfileSaveFailedEventArgs` | Raised when `SaveHandler` threw. |
| `Shared` | `ProfileSharedEventArgs` | Raised after Share tried to copy the link. |

Pseudo-classes: `:cover-medium`, `:stacked`, `:compact`, `:single-column`, `:editing`, `:framed`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### ProfileDetails

The person a `ProfilePage` shows: name, handle, headline, location, website, bio, pictures and when they joined. The page replaces the whole object after a successful save (see `Profile`).

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The display name, for example "Rowan Ellery". The activity rows use its first word. |
| `Handle` | `string` | `""` | The handle without the "@", for example "rowan". |
| `Headline` | `string` | `""` | A short line about the person's role, shown after the handle. |
| `Location` | `string` | `""` | Where the person is; the line is hidden while it is empty. |
| `Website` | `string` | `""` | A website without or with its scheme, for example "rowanellery.studio"; hidden while empty. |
| `Bio` | `string` | `""` | A few sentences about the person (the edit sheet caps it at `BioMaxLength`). |
| `Avatar` | `ImageSource?` | `null` | The portrait; without one the avatar shows the initials of `Name`. |
| `Cover` | `ImageSource?` | `null` | The wide picture at the top; drawn over `CoverBrush`. |
| `CoverBrush` | `IBrush?` | `null` | A fill for the cover area, under `Cover` (default: the muted surface). |
| `JoinedText` | `string` | `""` | When the person joined, as shown after "Joined", for example "June 2020"; hidden while empty. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ProfileStat

One number under the bio, for example 3,107 followers. The page shows up to three.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Id` | `string?` | `null` | A key you choose (optional). |
| `Label` | `string` | `""` | The word under the number, for example "Followers". |
| `Value` | `long` | `0` | The number, shown with group separators (3,107). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ProfileActivity

One row of the Activity tab: "{first name} {Action} {Target}", an optional `Detail` line and a time. Rows are grouped under `Group` headings in the order the groups first appear.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Kind` | `ProfileActivityKind` | `Shipped` | What happened; picks the icon. |
| `Action` | `string` | `""` | The verb after the name, for example "shipped" or "commented on". |
| `Target` | `string` | `""` | What it happened to, shown in the strong color, for example "Color tokens v3". |
| `Detail` | `string?` | `null` | An optional second line, for example a quote from the comment. |
| `TimeText` | `string` | `""` | When, as shown at the end of the row, for example "3h" or "Aug 30". |
| `Group` | `string` | `""` | The heading this row is listed under, for example "This week". |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ProfileProject

A card of the Projects tab: a cover, the title and visibility, a description, collaborators, when it was updated and a star button. Starring writes `IsStarred` and `StarCount` back.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Id` | `string?` | `null` | A key you choose; reported by `StarChanged`. |
| `Title` | `string` | `""` | The project's name (one line, cut with an ellipsis). |
| `Description` | `string` | `""` | One or two lines about it. |
| `Visibility` | `ProfileProjectVisibility` | `Public` | Public or private; shown at the end of the title line. |
| `UpdatedText` | `string` | `""` | When it last changed, as shown, for example "Updated 3h ago". |
| `StarCount` | `int` | `0` | How many stars it has (two-way: the star button adds or removes one). |
| `IsStarred` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the viewer has starred it (two-way). |
| `Cover` | `ImageSource?` | `null` | The picture at the top of the card; drawn over `CoverBrush`. |
| `CoverBrush` | `IBrush?` | `null` | A fill for the cover area, under `Cover` (default: the muted surface). |
| `Collaborators` | `AvaloniaList<ProfileCollaborator>` | `null` | The people on it, drawn as overlapping faces. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ProfileCollaborator

A person working on a `ProfileProject`, drawn as a small overlapping face.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The person's name (initials without a portrait, and the accessible name). |
| `Avatar` | `ImageSource?` | `null` | The portrait (optional). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ProfilePageLabels

Every word `ProfilePage` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; formatted texts are functions so that word order can change.

## Accessibility

Keyboard:

- **Tab** moves through Share, Edit profile, the website link, the chosen tab and the star buttons of the Projects tab.
- **Left / Right** on a tab move to the other tab and show it at once, wrapping around.
- **Enter / Space** press the focused button or star.
- In the sheet the focus starts in Name and **Tab / Shift+Tab** stay inside it. **Enter** in a one-line field saves; in
  the bio it starts a new line. **Escape** closes the sheet without saving, and the focus returns to Edit profile.

Screen readers:

- The about column, the tab column and the tab row are named ("About", "Profile content", "Profile sections"). The tabs
  are tab items; only the chosen one is a tab stop. Icons and the dot between the handle and the headline are hidden from
  screen readers.
- The Share button is a polite live region: its new name (Copied, Failed) is read, and the result is announced.
- Each star button is named with the project and its count ("Star Signup study, 34 stars", "Unstar …" once starred).
- The sheet is named by its title. Each field is named by its label; an error is given as the field's help text. A failed
  save is shown in an assertive live region and announced; a successful one is announced as "Profile saved".
- Keyboard focus rings are 2px, outside the element; focus moved by the pointer shows none.

## Motion

- **Tabs**: the underline glides to the chosen tab, position and width together, on a critically damped spring (Smooth,
  about 0.9 s). The old content fades out over 120ms, then the new one fades in and rises 6px over 240ms; the panel's
  height follows on the same spring once the new content is in. Turning back mid-way fades the old content back in.
- **Edit sheet**: slides in from its full width on the Smooth spring while the scrim fades in over 240ms; it leaves on a
  faster critically damped spring (about 250ms).
- **Saved fields**: each changed field gets an accent-subtle background reaching 3px past it, held for 480ms and faded
  over 1120ms.
- **Stars**: starring pops the star from 60% on a quick spring; the count changes at once. Unstarring does not animate.
- **Labels**: Share and Save swap their labels with a short fade, a 2px blur and a 3px rise, without changing width.
- **Reduced motion**: the underline and the content swap at once, the sheet fades in (160ms) and out instead of sliding,
  labels swap at once and the star does not pop. The save glow is kept (nothing moves). **Off** applies every change at
  once and skips the glow.

## Related

- `SettingsPage` and `SecuritySettings` for account settings.
- `Avatar` and `AvatarGroup` for portraits elsewhere.
- `Tabs` for tabs outside this block.
- `Drawer` for a window-level side panel.

# API keys

> API key management where a Create key pill unfolds into a form, the new secret is shown once, rows open into usage details and a hold revokes a key.

- Package: `TKCode.Arc.Blocks`, `dotnet add package TKCode.Arc.Blocks --version 0.3.2-preview.1`
- XAML namespace: `xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"`
- Live page: https://docs.tkcode.si/blocks/api-keys

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ApiKeysPreviewDemo">
    <!-- Five keys and four scopes (ApiKeysDemoData). No GenerateAction: the block simulates a server (about 730ms). -->
    <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Block"
                 Margin="0,12"
                 Description="Keys let your backend call the Northwind Relay API. Store them in a vault, never in client code."
                 CurrentUserName="Lena Ortiz" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ApiKeysPreviewDemo : UserControl
{
    public ApiKeysPreviewDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Block.Keys.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Keys());
        Block.Scopes.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Scopes());
    }
}
```

## When to use

`ApiKeys` is the keys page of an API product's developer settings. A header explains what the keys are for, a toolbar
counts the active keys, and each key is a row with its name, test or live badge, the last four characters, its scopes and
when it was last used. Creating and revoking happen in place, so people never leave the list:

- **Creating a key.** The "Create key" pill unfolds into a form: a name, Test or Live, and the scopes. Your server
  creates the key, and the same panel then shows the full secret once, with a copy button and a warning, while the new
  row slides in at the top of the list, highlighted until the panel closes.
- **Checking a key.** A row opens into its details: who created it, the last request (when and where from) and how many
  requests it signed in the last 30 days. Keys that have not been used for a while carry a warning.
- **Revoking a key.** The details end with a hold-to-revoke button. Holding it for 1.2 seconds strikes the row through;
  your server revokes the key and the row folds away.

## When not to use

- **Secrets people read again.** The block shows a secret exactly once. For values that stay readable (configuration,
  environment variables), use a masked field with a reveal button instead.
- **Personal access tokens with expiry rules or many permissions.** The form offers a name, two environments and a flat
  list of scopes. A token with expiry dates, resource pickers or per-project permissions needs a full form page.
- **Hundreds of keys.** Rows are not virtualized; the block is designed for a few to a few dozen keys. Search and paging
  belong in a data table.
- **Read-only lists.** If nobody can create or revoke keys here, a plain list or a data table is simpler.

## Usage

The block derives from Avalonia's `TemplatedControl`. Each key is an `ApiKeyItem` (an `AvaloniaObject`): a name, the
environment, the prefix and last four characters that identify it (never the secret), its scopes, the creation date and
creator, the last use and the request count. The scopes the form offers are `ApiKeyScope`s with a name, a description and
whether new keys start with them ticked.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc">
    <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Keys"
                 Description="Keys let your backend call the Northwind Relay API. Store them in a vault, never in client code." />
</UserControl>
```

```csharp
Keys.Scopes.Add(new ApiKeyScope { Name = "orders:write", Description = "Create, update and cancel orders" });
Keys.Scopes.Add(new ApiKeyScope { Name = "accounts:read", Description = "Read account profiles and contacts", IsDefault = true });

var checkout = new ApiKeyItem
{
    Key = "checkout",
    Name = "Checkout service",
    Environment = ApiKeyEnvironment.Live,
    Prefix = "rk_live_",
    LastFour = "7c3e",
    LastUsedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now.AddMinutes(-4),
    CreatedAt = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 2, 11, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero),
    CreatedBy = "Lena Ortiz",
    LastRequestText = "4 min ago from 18.144.62.10, Frankfurt",
    RequestsLast30Days = 942_317,
};
checkout.Scopes.AddRange(["orders:write", "accounts:read"]);
Keys.Keys.Add(checkout);
```

### Anatomy

- **Header**: `Title` (a level 2 heading, "API keys" by default) and `Description`, at most 520 wide.
- **Toolbar**: the count ("5 active keys", the number rolling up or down as it changes) and the "Create key" pill at the
  end. The whole pill is clickable, its text included. While the panel is open the count fades out.
- **Rows**: a whole-row button with four columns (name, badge and mask; scope chips; last use and creation date; a
  chevron). Its details open below it: facts, then a line with a note and the hold-to-revoke button.
- **Empty state**: a title, a line and an optional button (`EmptyActionText`), shown once the last row has folded away.

### Creating keys on your server

Set `GenerateAction` to the call that creates the key. It receives an `ApiKeyRequest` (the trimmed name, the
environment, the ticked scopes and the attempt number) and a cancellation token, and returns an `ApiKeyCreated`: the new
row and the one-time secret. While it runs `PanelState` is `Generating`: Generate shows a spinner and keeps the focus,
the fields are locked, and Escape cancels the request and returns to the form. The block keeps the secret only while the
reveal is open and drops it when the panel closes.

```csharp
Keys.GenerateAction = async (request, cancellation) =>
{
    var created = await api.CreateAsync(request.Name, request.Environment, request.Scopes, cancellation);
    var item = new ApiKeyItem
    {
        Key = created.Id,
        Name = request.Name,
        Environment = request.Environment,
        Prefix = created.Prefix,
        LastFour = created.Secret[^4..],
        CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now,
        CreatedBy = currentUser.Name,
    };
    item.Scopes.AddRange(request.Scopes);
    return new ApiKeyCreated(item, created.Secret);
};
```

The new row is inserted at the top of `Keys` (or of `KeysSource` when it is a list you can add to), `KeyCreated` fires
and `KeyCreatedCommand` runs. Without a `GenerateAction` the block simulates a server: about 730 ms, then a random
40-character secret starting with `SimulatedPrefixFormat`, recorded as created by `CurrentUserName`. Use that only for
prototypes and demos.

The form resets on every open: an empty name, `DefaultEnvironment`, and the scopes marked `IsDefault`. An empty name
shows an error under the field and keeps the focus there; no scope shows an error under the scopes and focuses the first
one. Both clear as soon as the person types or ticks a scope. Enter in the name field submits.

### Failure and retry

When `GenerateAction` throws, the form stays open with everything the person entered, an error line appears above the
buttons (the exception's message, or `ApiKeyLabels.GenerateFailed`), `GenerateError` holds it and `KeyCreateFailed`
fires. Pressing Generate again retries with the next attempt number. When `RevokeAction` throws, the struck-through row
comes back as it was, the hold button resets, the error is announced and `KeyRevokeFailed` fires.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ApiKeysFailingDemo">
    <StackPanel Spacing="12" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Block"
                     Description="The first key you generate here fails, as a busy key service could; the retry goes through. Revoking Ledger sync fails too." />
        <TextBlock x:Name="Log"
                   HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                   TextAlignment="Center"
                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                   MaxWidth="560"
                   Text="Create a key, then try again after the error." />
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ApiKeysFailingDemo : UserControl
{
    private bool _failedOnce;

    public ApiKeysFailingDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Block.Keys.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Keys());
        Block.Scopes.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Scopes());

        // The first generate is refused after a second; every later one goes through.
        Block.GenerateAction = async (request, cancellation) =>
        {
            await Task.Delay(1000, cancellation);
            if (!_failedOnce)
            {
                _failedOnce = true;
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The key service is busy right now. Try again in a moment.");
            }
            return ApiKeysDemoData.Create(request);
        };

        // Revoking the idle ledger key fails: the row comes back and the error is announced.
        Block.RevokeAction = async (item, cancellation) =>
        {
            await Task.Delay(600, cancellation);
            if (item.Key == "ledger")
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Ledger sync is used by a scheduled export. Pause the export first.");
            }
        };

        Block.KeyCreateFailed += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Attempt {e.Request.Attempt} failed: {e.Exception.Message}";
        Block.KeyCreated += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Created {e.Item.Name} on attempt {e.Request.Attempt}.";
        Block.KeyRevokeFailed += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"{e.Item.Name} is still active: {e.Exception.Message}";
        Block.KeyRevoked += (_, e) => Log.Text = $"Revoked {e.Item.Name}.";
    }
}
```

### Revoking

Holding the button for `RevokeHoldDuration` (1.2 s, by pointer or by holding Space or Enter) confirms. `KeyRevoking`
fires first and can cancel. Then the name and the mask are struck through, the rest of the row dims, and
`RevokeAction` runs; the row stays like that for at least `RevokeExitDelay` (0.9 s) and folds away when both are done.
The key is removed from `Keys` (or from a `KeysSource` list), `KeyRevoked` fires with the row's former index and
`KeyRevokedCommand` runs. `RevokeAsync` does the same from code, without the hold.

### Details and idle keys

`ExpandedKey` (two-way) is the row whose details are open; only one row is open at a time. `LastRequestText` fills the
"Last request" fact; without it the block writes how long ago the key was used. A key whose `LastUsedAt` is older than
`StaleAfter` (30 days) shows a warning before its last use, and its revoke note says how many days it has been idle.
`ReferenceTime` fixes "now" for these texts (tests, screenshots).

### Narrow containers

The block follows its own width, not the window's. Below 700 the scopes column and the creation date leave the rows
(the last use moves to the end) and appear in the details instead. Below 540 the side paddings tighten from 20 to 16,
the facts stack in one column and the revoke button moves under its note. When the open panel is 560 wide or less the
form uses one column, with the hint on its own line above the buttons.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ApiKeysCompactDemo">
    <!-- 390 wide: rows keep the name and the last use; scopes and the creation date move into the details, which stack. -->
    <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Block"
                 Width="390"
                 Margin="0,12"
                 HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                 Description="Keys let your backend call the Northwind Relay API. Store them in a vault, never in client code."
                 CurrentUserName="Lena Ortiz" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ApiKeysCompactDemo : UserControl
{
    public ApiKeysCompactDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Block.Keys.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Keys());
        Block.Scopes.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Scopes());
        Block.Expand(Block.Keys[0]);
    }
}
```

### Empty state

With no keys the list shows `ApiKeyLabels.EmptyTitle` and `EmptyDescription`. Set `EmptyActionText` to add a button: it
raises `EmptyActionInvoked` and runs `EmptyActionCommand`; when neither handles it, it opens the form. Added keys grow in
together, and the count rolls up.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ApiKeysEmptyDemo">
    <!-- No keys yet. The empty state's button brings the samples back; all five grow in at once. -->
    <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Block"
                 Margin="0,12"
                 IsFramed="False"
                 Description="Keys let your backend call the Northwind Relay API. Store them in a vault, never in client code."
                 CurrentUserName="Lena Ortiz"
                 EmptyActionText="Bring back sample keys" />
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ApiKeysEmptyDemo : UserControl
{
    public ApiKeysEmptyDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Block.Scopes.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Scopes());

        // Handled: the button restores the samples instead of opening the form (its default).
        Block.EmptyActionInvoked += (_, e) =>
        {
            e.Handled = true;
            Block.Keys.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Keys());
        };
    }
}
```

### Events and state

`PanelState` (`Closed`, `Form`, `Generating`, `Reveal`) and `PanelStateChanged` with the reason the panel closed (Cancel,
Done, the close toggle, Escape or code) let the page follow the panel; `IsCreateOpen` (two-way), `OpenCreate` and
`CloseCreate` drive it. `ActiveCount` is the number of listed keys. `SecretCopied` fires when the secret was copied.

```xml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:arc="https://github.com/AIDotNet/TKCode.Arc"
             x:Class="TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos.ApiKeysEventLogDemo">
    <StackPanel Spacing="12" Margin="0,12">
        <arc:ApiKeys x:Name="Block"
                     Description="Keys let your backend call the Northwind Relay API. Store them in a vault, never in client code." />
        <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="12">
            <StackPanel Spacing="4" VerticalAlignment="Top">
                <TextBlock x:Name="State" FontWeight="Medium" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="Expanded" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="Count" />
            </StackPanel>
            <TextBlock x:Name="Log" Grid.Column="1" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
        </Grid>
    </StackPanel>
</UserControl>
```

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;

namespace TKCode.Arc.Gallery.Demos;

public partial class ApiKeysEventLogDemo : UserControl
{
    private readonly List<string> _lines = new();

    public ApiKeysEventLogDemo()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Block.Keys.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Keys());
        Block.Scopes.AddRange(ApiKeysDemoData.Scopes());

        // A server that takes 900ms; every event and the bound state are written below the block.
        Block.GenerateAction = async (request, cancellation) =>
        {
            Write($"GenerateAction: \"{request.Name}\", {request.Environment}, {string.Join(", ", request.Scopes)}");
            await Task.Delay(900, cancellation);
            return ApiKeysDemoData.Create(request);
        };
        Block.RevokeAction = async (item, cancellation) =>
        {
            Write($"RevokeAction: {item.Name}");
            await Task.Delay(400, cancellation);
        };

        Block.PanelStateChanged += (_, e) =>
            Write(e.CloseReason is { } reason ? $"Panel: {e.OldState} → {e.NewState} ({reason})" : $"Panel: {e.OldState} → {e.NewState}");
        Block.KeyCreated += (_, e) => Write($"KeyCreated: {e.Item.Name} ({e.Item.MaskedText})");
        Block.SecretCopied += (_, e) => Write($"SecretCopied: {e.Item.Name}");
        Block.ExpandedKeyChanged += (_, e) => Write($"ExpandedKeyChanged: {e.OldItem?.Name ?? "none"} → {e.NewItem?.Name ?? "none"}");
        Block.KeyRevoking += (_, e) => Write($"KeyRevoking: {e.Item.Name}");
        Block.KeyRevoked += (_, e) => Write($"KeyRevoked: {e.Item.Name} (was row {e.Index + 1})");

        Block.PropertyChanged += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.Property == ApiKeys.PanelStateProperty || e.Property == ApiKeys.ExpandedKeyProperty
                || e.Property == ApiKeys.ActiveCountProperty)
            {
                ShowState();
            }
        };
        ShowState();
    }

    private void ShowState()
    {
        State.Text = $"PanelState: {Block.PanelState}";
        Expanded.Text = $"ExpandedKey: {Block.ExpandedKey?.Name ?? "none"}";
        Count.Text = $"ActiveCount: {Block.ActiveCount}";
    }

    private void Write(string line)
    {
        _lines.Insert(0, line);
        if (_lines.Count > 8)
        {
            _lines.RemoveAt(_lines.Count - 1);
        }
        Log.Text = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, _lines);
    }
}
```

### Texts

Every word the block shows or announces is in `Labels`, an `ApiKeyLabels` with English defaults. Texts that include a
value are functions, so word order can change:

```csharp
Keys.Labels = new ApiKeyLabels
{
    CreateKey = "New key",
    CountWords = count => count == 1 ? "key in use" : "keys in use",
    Used = ago => $"Last call {ago}",
};
```

## API reference

### ApiKeys

A key manager for an API's developer settings: a header, a toolbar with the number of active keys and a "Create key" pill, and the keys as rows. The pill unfolds in place into a form (name, test or live, scopes); submitting runs `GenerateAction` and the same panel then shows the new secret once, with a copy button, while the new row slides in at the top, highlighted until the panel closes. A row opens into its details (creator, last request, request count) and a hold-to-revoke button; a confirmed revoke strikes the row through, runs `RevokeAction` and folds the row away.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | `string?` | `"API keys"` | The heading; null leaves it out. |
| `Description` | `string?` | `null` | The line under the heading (at most 520 wide); null leaves it out. |
| `KeysSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The keys, when you give them as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Keys`. |
| `ScopesSource` | `IEnumerable?` | `null` | The scopes the form offers, when you give them as a list; it wins over `Scopes`. |
| `IsCreateOpen` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the "Create key" panel is open (two-way). |
| `DefaultEnvironment` | `ApiKeyEnvironment` | `Test` | The environment a fresh form starts with. |
| `NameMaxLength` | `int` | `40` | The longest name the form accepts (40). |
| `GenerateAction` | `Func<ApiKeyRequest, CancellationToken, Task<ApiKeyCreated>>?` | `null` | Creates the key on your server: awaited when the form is submitted, with what the person asked for and a token that Escape, closing the panel or the block leaving the window cancels. Return the new row and its one-time secret. An exception keeps the form open with the error in it; a cancellation returns to the form quietly. Null simulates a server (about 730ms, a random 40-character secret). |
| `RevokeAction` | `Func<ApiKeyItem, CancellationToken, Task>?` | `null` | Revokes the key on your server: awaited once the hold is confirmed, while the row shows it struck through. An exception restores the row and announces the error. Null revokes at once. |
| `KeyCreatedCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Run with the new `ApiKeyItem` after a key was created. |
| `KeyRevokedCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Run with the `ApiKeyItem` after a key was revoked and left the list. |
| `SimulatedPrefixFormat` | `string` | `"rk_{0}_"` | The prefix of simulated secrets; {0} is "test" or "live" (used only while `GenerateAction` is null). |
| `CurrentUserName` | `string?` | `null` | The creator recorded on simulated keys (used only while `GenerateAction` is null). |
| `ReferenceTime` | `DateTimeOffset?` | `null` | "Now" for the relative dates and the stale check; null reads the clock. |
| `StaleAfter` | `TimeSpan` | `30.00:00:00` | A key whose last request is older than this is marked as idle (30 days). |
| `RevokeHoldDuration` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:01.2000000` | How long the revoke button must be held (1.2 s). |
| `RevokeExitDelay` | `TimeSpan` | `00:00:00.9000000` | How long a revoked row stays struck through before it folds away (0.9 s; longer when the server is slower). |
| `EmptyActionText` | `string?` | `null` | The button text of the empty state; null shows no button. |
| `EmptyActionCommand` | `ICommand?` | `null` | Run when the empty state's button is pressed; when null and `EmptyActionInvoked` is not handled, the form opens. |
| `ExpandedKey` | `ApiKeyItem?` | `null` | The key whose details are open (two-way); null when every row is closed. |
| `IsFramed` | `bool` | `true` | Draws a bordered card with rounded corners (true); false lays the block flat on the page. |
| `Labels` | `ApiKeyLabels` | – | Every word the block shows or announces. |
| `ActiveCount` | `int` | – | *Read-only.* How many keys are listed (a revoked key counts until its row has left). |
| `PanelState` | `ApiKeysPanelState` | – | *Read-only.* What the "Create key" panel shows. |
| `GenerateError` | `string?` | – | *Read-only.* The error the form shows after a failed generate; null otherwise. |

| Event | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KeyCreated` | `ApiKeyCreatedEventArgs` | Raised when a key was created and listed, before its secret shows. |
| `KeyCreateFailed` | `ApiKeyCreateFailedEventArgs` | Raised when `GenerateAction` threw; the form stays open with the error. |
| `SecretCopied` | `ApiKeySecretCopiedEventArgs` | Raised when the one-time secret was copied. |
| `KeyRevoking` | `ApiKeyRevokingEventArgs` | Raised when a revoke is confirmed, before anything changes; set `Cancel` to keep the key. |
| `KeyRevoked` | `ApiKeyRevokedEventArgs` | Raised when a key was revoked and its row left the list. |
| `KeyRevokeFailed` | `ApiKeyRevokeFailedEventArgs` | Raised when `RevokeAction` threw; the row is restored. |
| `ExpandedKeyChanged` | `ApiKeyExpandedEventArgs` | Raised when a row's details open or close. |
| `PanelStateChanged` | `ApiKeysPanelStateChangedEventArgs` | Raised when `PanelState` changes. |
| `EmptyActionInvoked` | `RoutedEventArgs` | Raised when the empty state's button is pressed; mark it handled to keep the form closed. |

Pseudo-classes: `:framed`, `:narrow`, `:compact`, `:empty`, `:form`, `:generating`, `:reveal`

Derives from `TemplatedControl`: every member of `TemplatedControl` works as well.

### ApiKeyItem

One API key in an `ApiKeys` list. It never holds the secret itself: only the prefix and the last four characters that identify it.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Key` | `string` | `""` | A stable identifier (events, automation ids). |
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The name people gave the key; the row's title. |
| `Environment` | `ApiKeyEnvironment` | `Test` | Test or live; shown as a badge next to the name. |
| `Prefix` | `string` | `""` | The visible start of the secret ("rk_live_"). |
| `LastFour` | `string` | `""` | The last four characters of the secret. |
| `LastUsedAt` | `DateTimeOffset?` | `null` | When the key last signed a request; null means it was never used. |
| `LastUsedText` | `string?` | `null` | Replaces the generated "Used …" line when set. |
| `CreatedAt` | `DateTimeOffset` | `01/01/0001 00:00:00 +00:00` | When the key was created. |
| `CreatedBy` | `string?` | `null` | The name of the person who created the key (detail, next to an avatar with their initials). |
| `LastRequestText` | `string?` | `null` | The "Last request" fact (when and where from); null derives it from `LastUsedAt`. |
| `RequestsLast30Days` | `long` | `0` | How many requests the key signed in the last 30 days. |
| `Tag` | `object?` | `null` | Anything the app wants to keep with the key. |
| `MaskedText` | `string` | – | *Read-only.* The prefix, four dots and the last four characters ("rk_live_••••7c3e"). |
| `IsRevoked` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True from the moment a revoke is confirmed until the row leaves (or the revoke fails). |
| `IsFresh` | `bool` | – | *Read-only.* True for a key just created, until its one-time secret panel closes (the row stays highlighted). |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ApiKeyScope

A scope that the "Create key" form of `ApiKeys` offers.

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | `string` | `""` | The scope's identifier, shown in a monospaced face ("orders:write"). |
| `Description` | `string?` | `null` | One line on what the scope allows. |
| `IsDefault` | `bool` | `false` | Whether a fresh form starts with this scope ticked. |

Derives from `AvaloniaObject`: every member of `AvaloniaObject` works as well.

### ApiKeyRequest

What the person asked for in the "Create key" form: passed to `GenerateAction`.

### ApiKeyCreated

A key the server created: the row to add and the secret to show once.

### ApiKeyLabels

Every word `ApiKeys` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; formatted texts are functions so that word order can change.

## Accessibility

- The block is named by its title, a level 2 heading. The count is read as one phrase ("5 active keys").
- The toggle is named "Create key", and "Close" while the panel is open. The scopes are a group named "Scopes"; each
  checkbox is named by its scope and described by its line. Validation errors are alerts.
- The secret box is named "Secret key". The secret is never put anywhere else in the visual tree.
- The list is named "Active keys". Each row's button reads the name, environment, "Key ending in 7c3e", the scopes and
  the dates, with "Idle" before the last use of a stale key, and reports whether its details are expanded. The details
  are named "<name> details". The hold button is named "Hold to revoke: <name>".
- Opening a row, copying the secret, creating a key, revoking a key and a failed revoke are announced politely.
  A failed generate shows an assertive error line.
- The keyboard focus ring of a row is drawn inside the row, so its clipping never hides it.

### Keyboard

- **Tab** reaches the "Create key" toggle, then each row. An open row's hold button follows its row.
- **Enter** or **Space** on the toggle opens the form and focuses the name. **Tab** then moves through the environment
  switch (one stop; arrows choose), the scopes, Cancel and Generate. The form does not trap the focus.
- **Enter** in the name field submits. **Escape** anywhere in the panel closes it and returns the focus to the toggle;
  while a key is being generated, Escape cancels the request instead and stays in the form.
- After a key is created the focus moves to the Copy button.
- **Enter** or **Space** on a row opens or closes its details.
- **Space** or **Enter** held on the hold button revokes after 1.2 s; releasing early cancels.
- After a revoke the focus moves to the next row, else to the previous one, else to the "Create key" toggle.

## Motion

- **Pill to panel**: one smooth spring grows the surface leftward to the full width and down to the form; the plus turns
  45° into a close cross; the form fades in after 140 ms; the count fades out. Closing fades the body out in 100 ms, folds
  the surface back and fades the count in after 100 ms.
- **Form**: the hint under the form blur-swaps when the environment changes; the error lines open on the smooth spring.
- **Generate**: the title blur-swaps to "Key created"; the form fades out in 120 ms and the reveal rises 8 px while
  fading in (320 ms after 60 ms); the secret develops from an 8 px blur over 480 ms. The new row grows in from zero
  height on the smooth spring with a 240 ms fade after 80 ms and keeps its accent tint until the panel closes, then the
  tint fades over 1.2 s after 300 ms. The count rolls up.
- **Rows**: the details open on the smooth spring and fade in over 240 ms after 50 ms; closing fades them out in 160 ms.
  The chevron turns 180° on a 580 ms spring curve; the open tint changes in 160 ms. Only one row is open.
- **Revoke**: the hold fills linearly; once confirmed, a line strikes through the name (480 ms) and, 80 ms later, through
  the mask; the rest dims to 40% in 240 ms. After the pause the row folds away on the smooth spring and the rows below
  follow; the count rolls down.
- Reduced motion places sizes and positions at once and keeps only short fades; the hold still fills over 1.2 s. Off
  applies every change at once.

## Related

- `HoldToConfirm`, `CopyButton`, `Input`, `SegmentedControl`, `Checkbox`, `Badge` and `Avatar`, the controls the block
  is made of.
- Webhooks, Integrations and Env variables, the other Developer blocks.
